tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil chog dbang gi chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi chu bo chen po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen thabs kyi gzhom med rdo rje dang*// stong nyid shes rab kun gsal pad+ma'i mchog /gnyis med sbyor ba'i rgyud rgyal he badz+ra// mtshon cha 'bar ba thogs la gus btud nas// kha sbyor rgyud rgyal gangs ri'i phreng ba der| |grub chen tsha zer 'od kyis bskul ba'i tshe// dbang gi chu bo chen po gang bab pa// mkhas mchog gar gyi dbang po la btud de// bdag blo'i bum pa yongs su gang gyur pas// de dag gzhan gyi tshul min ma 'dres shing*// rgyud don tshul dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi// cho ga snyan tshig rlabs phreng g.yo ba 'di// gal te nges par 'khor pa'i mtsho 'di las// thar 'dod ngang mo'i cho ga yod srid na// dbang gi chu bo che 'dir blo gros kyi// zlos gar ci yang bsgyur ba'i rol rtsed kyis// smin byed don gyi nor bu da longs shig /'di la gnyis te/ sngon du bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang gi cho ga'o// dang po la drug /smin byed slob dpon/ smin bya'i slob ma/ phan tshun brtag pa/ gsol ba gdab pa/ pha rol bsrung bar bya ba/ gnang ba zhu ba rnams so// dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid rgyud nas gsungs pa mang du yod pas 'dir ma bris shing*/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'ang rtogs sla bas 'dir ma bris/ bzhi pa ni/ slob mas slob dpon la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas dkyil 'khor bri bar gsol ba gdab pa'o// de yang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul te phyag byas la/ pus mo btsugs shing thal mo sbyar// zhes dang*/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas/ thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lhas// 'khor ba'i 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa'o//

lnga pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma'i bgegs bsal zhing bsrungs la/ dkyil 'khor sngags yun du zlos bcug cing dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad ma 'dzom pa rnams tshags su gzhug cing slob dpon gyis kyang nyer bsdogs bya'o// drug pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i tshe lha la gnang ba thob pa zhig slob dpon du nges par dgos mod/ phreng ba las/ de ltar sngon du bsnyen pa rgyas pa byas pas skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang spro ba dang bsdu ba mngon du bya ba nus pas/ 'khor lo gnas pa nyid kyi 'khor lo can gyi ma bkag pa'am/ tshogs bsags pa nyid kyi gnang bas dkyil 'khor dang rab tu gnas pa dang slob ma bsdu ba la sogs pa bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir yang bsnyen pa kha gso zhing gnas gtsang mar khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i mdun du 'jig rten dbang phyug dmigs la mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ mu tsi lī swā hā/ oṃ mo ha nī swā hā/ oṃ dan+ta lī swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas pas lag mthil g.yon par sngags/ sa kha la reg ste mgo lho dang kha shar du phyogs pas nyal te rmi lam brtags pas bzang ngan dang*/ gal te ngan na bzlog pa'i thabs bya zhing bzlas sngags bzla ba dang don dam par chos thams cad rang bzhin med par mos la/ slar brtags pas gnang ba'am ma bkag na dus dang gza' skar bzang po la 'jug par bya'o| | spyi rgyud las/ ston zla 'bring po'i nya nas ni/ dpyid zla tha chung nya'i bar/ */'di yi bar du mkhas pas bri// bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor nang bcad dang*/ de bzhin sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dag /dbyar mi dgos par dbyar yang ni// mkhas pas dus bzhir bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ tshes grangs ni/ zla ba nya'am bcu gsum mam// tshes brgyad dag gam bcu bzhi 'am// tshes bcu dang ni bcu bzhi gcig

/tshes lnga yang na tshes bdun nam// yang na tshes grangs gsum yang rung*// nyi ma gcig pu 'di dag la// dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrigs te bri// zhes dang*/ gza' ni/ phur bu dang ni zla ba dang*// pa sangs dang ni nyi ma bzang*// zhes pa dang*/ skar ma ni/ rgyal dang skag dang sa ga dang*// me bzhi nag pa tha skar dang*// snron rnams dkyil 'khor dag la shis// zhes pa rnams so// gnyis pa la gsum/ sa chog sta gon dngos gzhi'o// dang po la lnga/ sa brtag pa bslang ba bzung ba bsrung ba'o// dang po/ lha khang dang dur khrod ba lang gi lhas sogs su sa brtag pa mi dgos la/ de ma yin par ni sa brtag pa'i thabs lto 'phye'i thig sogs kyis sa brkos pa'i tshe rus bu 'am/ sol ba/ shing la sogs pa thon pa'i rtags sogs man ngag ltar bya'o// gzhan yang spyi rgyud las/ phun sum tshogs pa kun tshang ba'i// tshogs pa dag ni rnyed par dka'// mdor na sa gzhi mnyam pa dang*// mdangs snum shar phyogs gzhol bar bzhi// phug dang ldan pa'i gnas dang ni// bdag gi mig yid mgu ba dang*// 'tshe med zug rngu spangs pa ste// dkyil 'khor gnas su shes pa ste// 'di yis dngos grub thob par byed// ces dang*/ */de nyid las/ der ni mtho gang tsam du ni/ */ khung bur brkos nas sa de nyid// khung bur myur du bkang ba na// gal te sa de lhag gyur pa// de la sa de bzang zhes bya// slar yang dong de bkang ba'i sa// mtho gang tsam du brkos pa yi// khung bu de ni chus bkang ba// nya phyis dang ni nya gson pa// ldan par zhes ni kha cig go// gom pa brgyar ni yang dag phyin// slar yang 'ongs nas brtag par bya// chu yis gang na sa bzang po// dma' ba phan pa 'dod pas spang*// gal te chu ni sgra dang bcas// klu rnams 'jigs pa yang dag ston// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po la sogs pa sa yi bdag po yod na de las bslang ngo*// gnang na dad med kyang gzhi der yo byad 'du byas la/

rang nyid skad cig zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod la/ 'jig rten pa'i mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis sa phyogs 'di'i zhing skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥzhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje dam tshig gis byon/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa mchod yon so sor bzhes/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sa 'di bdag gis bslang bgyid na// dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol// ces gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol bas gnang ba bstsal nas so sor gshegs par gyur par mos shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi der dri'i thig le'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar sa lha'i gtor ma dang mchod pa bshams la/ byin gyis brlabs te tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo lte ba man chad sa la nub pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin cing thugs zhi ba'i ngang tshul can na bza' dkar po dang rgyan bzang pos spras pa zhig gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya byas pa'i sor mo sa la bsnun pa gsum/ g.yas kyi lag mthil du zla ba hūm̐ gsum gsal ba'i 'od dang sor mo sa la bsnun pa'i sgras ye shes kyi sa lha 'og nas spyan drangs par mos la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba| |bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon la sogs bzhes nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor las rnams legs sgrub mdzod/

'di kha sbyor gyi brtag pa bdun pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhe drug pa nas gsungs/ hī hī hī hī baṃ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur zhes mos/ oṃ pṛ thi wīde wī bh+yaḥ sa'i lha mo rnams kyi ched du/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ a kā ros gtor ma phul te rdor dril thogs la/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// dgyes pa rdo rje khrus mchod nas// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// rdo rje 'dzin bdag dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol bas/ sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim pas sa'i ngo bor gnas par gyur ces mos/ phyi rgyud las/ drang srong gnas dang ba glang lhas// phug dang ri yi rtse mo dang*// sa gzhi gang na 'thas pa dang*// khang stong dang ni rdo leb dang*// mchod rten drung dang 'bab chu ri// mtsho rnams kyi ni 'gram dag tu// sa gzhi sbyang dang brtag pa dang*// nan tan du ma bya mi dgos// 'thas par bcags kyang der mi dgos// mtho dma' la sogs skyon rnams kyang*// der ni dogs pas dpyad mi dgos// zhes gnas de rnams su 'di yan chod kyi cho ga rnams bya mi dgos/ yang de nyid las/ sa yi bdag pos gnang nas ni// slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gsum pa ni/ der gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis las sngags brjod cing yungs kar dang*/ chu dang*/ thal bas brab cing ba chu dri bzang gis byugs la lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sa gzhi der reg la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/sa gzhi/ sa gzhi stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūm̐ rdo rje laṃ sa gzhi hūm̐ rdo rje sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐| sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo rjes chings/

rdo rjes bcings te brtan par gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐/bsnun bsnun rdo rje khro bo/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje gsum/ sho dha ya sho dha ya sbyongs shig sbyongs shig / rak+ṣa rak+ṣa srungs srungs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsum nyes skyon sbyangs shing bsrung bar gyur/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ sngags pa rtog par gnas nas su// gang zhig sa sbyong byed pa ni// byang chub sems ni rnam spangs pas// gsang ba'i bdag po de mi 'dag /de bas rtog pa rnam spangs nas// sa kun rnam par sbyang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg la sa la sogs pa'i sna tshogs pa'i chos can sna tshogs de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par dag par gyur zhes dmigs so// bzhi pa ni/ stegs bu der stegs bu 'chos pa'i tshe/ rdo ba sogs ma bsal ba'i nyes pa ni/ bshes spring las/ rdo bar bcas na rlung chen dang*// rus par bcas na zug gzer 'byung*// gyo dum dang bcas lkugs pa nyid// gseg ma sol ba ldan na rims// skra dang ba rtswa shing sogs bcas// nye bar 'tshe ba phra mo 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa'o// me tog bkram pa'i dbus su sgrub thabs ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar bya la/ rdor dril dang spos thogs te/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur zhes mos shing*/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ rdo rje rtse mo las byung*/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// bdag ni dgyes pa rdo rje yis// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri par bya// sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon tshe| |dngos grub 'dir ni gnang bar mdzod// ces phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la snyan gsan phab nas/ slar slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas shar du phyogs pas rdor dril 'dzin pas gtso bo'i nga rgyal bskyed la/ phyogs bzhir slob ma bzhi gau rī sogs bzhir mos la rdor dril thogs la bsdad pas/

slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor mos la ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ shar nas/ phyogs bzhis gsol ba gdab pa bzhi po 'di gsang 'dus las byung zhing*/ mi thub zla bas kyang*/ slob dpon rdo rje bsam mtshungs la// phyi nas rtags sogs rgyal ba dang*// mnyam par rdo rje dril 'chang ba'i// slob ma rnams kyi gsol ba gdab// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba| |de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lor bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab cing*/ slob ma gcig kho na yin na phyogs so sor song la gsol ba btab cing*/ slob ma med na rang gis mos pa bya zhing brjod/ slob dpon gyi lag gnyis rdor dril thogs pa'i rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyangs pa'i rtse mo gshibs pa kha 'og tu phyogs pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha/ rdo rje nye bar mnos shig / zhes bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis kha shar du phyogs pas rdor dril thogs la thal mo spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ pra ṇā men sarba ta thā ga taṃ/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag bgyi'o// zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun pas bsgribs shing bdud kyi dbang du song ba rnams kyi bdud 'dul bar bgyi'o// de'i phyir rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal

rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rjer bskyed pa 'di nyin mo'i 'byung gnas dang dgyes pa rdo rje'i las rim cho ga las gsungs so// ba'i mig g.yas ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon ḍa las zla ba mig 'bras rgyal ba bzang po'i dgongs pa/ hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ ces rdo rje'i mig gis phyogs kun tu 'gro zhing bltas nas rdo rje gsor dril bu 'khrol zhing*/ nga ni nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i rtse mo las byung*/ rdo rje rdor sems rgyal po che// nga ni stobs chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal// phyag rdor brtan dang rdo rje bdag po che// byin gyis brlabs pa skad cig mi 'dor ro// zhes nga rgyal bzung ste/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol zhing hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod cing shar nas g.yas su bskor te dbang ldan gyi bar du phyin te der 'gying bas/ 'dus pa'i bcu gsum las byung ba/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems tshogs bgegs tshogs nga la nyon// nga ni rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khor los bsgyur// rdo rje'i gzugs kyi lus gsum skyes dag ste// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da' bas na// 'jig par 'gyur gyi 'dir ni gzhan du min// zhes gsum brjod la bka' bsgos la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa sogs brjod/ rang las khro bo mang po 'phros pas bgegs rnams bskrad de dbang chen gyi bar du dbyung ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces mos pas byin gyis brlabs so// de nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil bas rdo rje'i lta ba dang ldan pas rkang mthil rdo rje bskyed la dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi bskor ro//

lwa ba pa dang*/ dā ri ka pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa dang*/ bhu ti pa rnams kyis sngon du bka' bsgos nas de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa skor ba gsungs pa'i don no// lnga pa ni/ seng ldeng ngam lcags las byas pa'i phur bu srid du sor bcu sboms su de'i sum cha can bskyed pa dang mthun pa'i dbyibs can tsan+dan dmar po dang dri'i chus byugs pa tshon skud lngas dkris pa/ mgul du me tog dang yungs kar bcings pa bcu 'bras bus bkang ba'i phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og phyogs mtshams shar nub tu bkod la rdo rje'i tho ba rtse mor me tog bcings pa yang bzhag la phur bu tho ba bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu stod khro mo ghasma rī la lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa rno dbal dang ldan zhing*/ me 'bar ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi rab dbye las/ stod rang gi gzugs can smad phur bur 'dug pa bcu zhes/ li la badz+ras/ phur bu stod ni khro bo la// smad ni rdo rje rtse gcig pa// zhes dang*/ dā ri ka pas/ seng ldeng la sogs dri mar bkus// dar dmar me tog phreng ba btags// zhes gsungs shing*// tshon skud sna lngas dkri ba glu dbyangs kyis bshad do// ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje'i tho ba rang dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal pa'i g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ ces mos te langs la bka' bsgo ba'i tshe mi nyan pa'i phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis skad cig gis bkug nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa zab mo'i nang bcug ste spyi bor phur bu gdab par gyur/

ces phur bu gcig thogs pas dbang ldan gyi bur bu khung du bcug la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bigh+nāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kī li kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ya ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bcug cing phur khung de rnams sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor stegs bu'i mtha' me ri'i phyi rol tsam du 'ong bar byas la gdab/ sgom don ni/ phur khung rnams khron par bsam pa'i nang du bgegs bcug la spyi bor phur bu gdab par bsam mo// g.yon dril bu dkur brten/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i tho ba thogs nas brdung ba'i tshul byas la/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra badz+ra kī la ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la brdeg / mi thub zla bas/ phur bu'i mgo bor tho ba ni// bzhag pa lag pa gcig shos kyis// sngon gyi sngags kyis brdungs byas te// zhes pa'i don no// de bzhin du g.yas su bskor la phur bu rnams rim par gdab cing steng gi phur bu ni shar gyi shar dang*/ 'og gi phur bu ni nub kyi nub tu gdab bo// bgegs rnams spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar du phug pas srog dang phral zhing bde ba chen po'i ngo bor rang bzhin gcig par byas te bgegs lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas 'khor yug chen po'i bar du 'gro ba rnams rnam pa kun tu bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ ces brjod nas/ sgrub thabs ltar srung 'khor gsal gdab| nyin re'i thun gsum mam drug tu phur bu'i lha rnams la mchod gtor bshams la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī kī la ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī kī la ya a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ za phod phur bu khro mo che// dgra bgegs log 'dren 'khor dang bcas// gdug pa can rnams thams cad la// phur bu thob cig za phod ma// zhes brjod cing phur bu rnams la 'bul bar bya ba shin tu gal che'o// gal te phur bu med na yid kyis bskyed la gdab rdung gi sngags lan bcu brjod la/

rgyal ba bzang pos/ yang na ye shes kyis nus na// ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bu gdab// ces gsungs pa'i don no// lag pa g.yas gan rkyal du gnas pa sa la bsnun te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas mchod gtor phul bas chad lhag gi skyon du mi 'gyur te sgrub po nyams chung rnams kyis so// gnyis pa sta gon la'ang bzhi/ sa lha dkyil 'khor lha/ bum pa slob ma sta gon rnams so// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor stegs bur dri'i thig le la tshom bu bkod pa nas sa'i ngo bor gnas par gyur gyi bar sa slong ba'i skabs ltar las/ lag gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams kyis sa gzhi mnan la/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa hūm̐/ gsum brjod rdo rje'i bsdams pa las hūm̐ yig 'od 'bar ba 'phros pas sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha gsum brjod nas sa byin gyis brlabs so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ las thig dang*/ lha sta gon dngos so// dang po ni/ gtsang zhing 'jam pa'i ras bal la byas pa'i thig skud srid du dpon slob gnyis ka'i g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nas brtsams te/ sor mo bzhi'i rgyab nas dkris la de'i dbus su bcug ste mdzub mo'i steng nas bton pa mthe bong sa la sbyar ba'i bar ma gtogs dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur sboms su sgo'i nyis 'gyur gyi cha yod pa/ sum sgril dkar zhing 'jam la 'jur bu med pa bkal legs pa gzhon nu ma nyams pas bkal ba'am dpa' bo'i rin thang gis nyos pa zhig dgos la/ dā ri ka pas/ ma nyams ras bal gtsang ma las// zhes dang*/ spyi rgyud las/ de ni bu mo gzhon nus bkal// gsar pa shin tu gtsang ba dang*// mdzes shing shin tu ran pa dang*// dri zhim reg na bde ba dang*| |legs par bkal dang phra ba dang*// sbom phra ran pa bkal legs la// 'jur mdud med par gyur pa yi// thig skud me tog spos mchod la/ shes rab can gyis thig gdab bo// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhung 'ga' zhig tu sngar dkyil 'khor gzhan la longs ma spyad pa zer ba ni rnam par brtag par bya'o// de nyid dri zhim po'i chu dang bdud rtsi lnga'am ba'i rnam lngas byugs la/

thig skud kyi rtse mo gnyis dang dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur ces dmigs shing*/ dris byugs pa'i snod du bzhag /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las pad zla'i gdan la ghaṃ las sbrul dang bcas pa'i rkang mar gyi thod pa ghaṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las ghasma rī ljang khu zhes las bum ltar bskyed la gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par dmigs la/ oṃ ghasma rī ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ thig skud la lag pas reg cing las sngags bzlas pas bsrung*/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ḍa las nyi zla ser po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces mos la rdo rje'i lta bas bltas shing*/ oṃ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭa zhes brtan par byas te las sngags bzlas pa'i chu dang yungs kar dri bzang gi chus bran la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas thig skud la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ de nas bsang gtor gyi chu dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi der gtor zhing*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gtsang bar byas la dri bzang gi chu 'thor ba'i me tog phyi rol du bkram la| nam mkhar dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur ces mos shing*/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ bstod pa gang rung gis bstod cing*/ slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang*/ slob ma ghasma rīr gsal bar gyur zhes mos shing*/ slob dpon la rgyab mi ston pa'i 'gros kyis slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du langs la phyogs thams cad rang bzhin med pa mnyam pa nyid do// slob dpon gyi mig gnyis dzaḥlas skyes pa'i nyi zla 'od 'phro ba ser po can du gyur/

ces mos shing slob dpon gyi g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur lte ba'i thad du thig skud bzung la dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥbarjod cing*/ slar dz+dzaḥ gsum brjod nas rang dang slob mas dz+dzaḥgasum brjod cing*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis blangs te lte bar bzung*/ de nas slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ g.yas pa'i mthil sa la btsugs shing slob mas de las ldog ste 'dug la/ gnyis ka'i mthe bos thig skud sa la sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pas shar nub kyi tshangs thig gdab/ sdom 'byung gi bcu bdun pa las/ nub dang lho yi gnas su ni// slob dpon nges na yang dag gnas// shar dang byang gi phyogs su yang*// slob ma gnas te mnyam gzhag pa// zhes pa'i don no// de nas slob dpon gyi rkang mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje 'od 'phro ba re re gsal bar gyur/ ces pas rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis g.yas skor du song ste slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas lho byang gi tshangs thig dang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ dā ri ka pas/ g.yon nas bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis// rnam pa kun tu thig gdab bya// mtshams kyi cha ni g.yas su ste// zhes mtshams g.yon skor dang phyogs g.yas skor du byed pa'ang bshad do// slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa dang*/ slar yang slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma me rlung du lho dang nub kyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon rlung dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi rtsa thig gdab bo// skor phyogs dang rkang stabs sogs kun la nges par bya zhing*| rdo rje khu tshur gyis thig skud rtag tu 'dzin ma nus na gnas thig chen brgyad dang thig bzhi'i yun rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung la/

de lhag rnams la ci bder bya'o// theg chen brgyad kyi tshe thig skud chad pa sogs byung na mtshan ma ngan pas bzlog pa'i thabs bya'o// spyi rgyud las/ ltas ngan byung na dngos mi 'grub// ring thung cher na nad kyis thebs// zhes dang*/ de bas thams cad nan tan du// mkhas pas legs par thig gdab bo// zhes dang*/ dā ri ka pas/ phyogs 'khrug slob ma nyon mongs 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// thig rtsa dngos ni logs gtub sogs logs na yod pa ltar gdab cing*/ dkyil 'khor ni dbus su cha chen gcig khyams dang*/ de'i nang du lha snam gru bzhi/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud ge sar dang bcas pa bri zhing*/ rta babs snam bu bcu gcig gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam| gu ṇa ha ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du cha chen gcig gi sum gnyis kyi pad ra dang cha chen gcig gi dur khrod dang*/ cha chen gcig rdo ra dang cha chen gcig gis me ri bya'o// sdom 'byung las/ rdo rje ra ba'i nang du ni// dur khrod kyis ni brgyan pa'o// zhes dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ phyi rol 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// tshon gyi sa yi nyis 'gyur tshangs// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don no// zlum thig bskor ba'i tshe seng ldeng gi phur bu steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ 'og rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur bur gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ tho ba sngar ltar bskyed la gdab rdung gi sngags brjod cing thig chen brgyad kyi dbus kyi rgya gram ma 'dzol bar gdab/ 'dir sngags brjod pa ma gtogs bgegs zhes bya ba'i 'don pa mi dgos la/ phur bu gdab rdung gi sngags dang tho bas rdeg pa sogs bsam gtan gyis byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas thig skud gnyis gdab rgyu dngos su phur bu'i mgul du btags pa res mos bzung la skor phyogs sngar ltar byas la/

dbang ldan nas brtsams te skor dgos pa re bzhi pa las bshad/ 'khor yug dang lta ba rnams bskor te zin pa dang*| slob dpon g.yon brkyang gis gnas pas lag gnyis rdor dril thogs pa'i mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar byas la phan tshun 'khyud pa skam pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badz+ra kī la udakī la ya sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes phur bu phyung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis/ rdor dril 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du kha phyogs pas 'grengs te/ rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rje sgyu ma lta bu'i mig gnyis su hī las byung ba'i nyi zla 'od zer ser po can du gyur par mos pas/ khro bo'i lta stangs kyis phyogs kun tu lta zhing*/ hī hī hī hī/ thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa rnams dbye bar bgyi'o// zhes pas sgo'i nang gi rtsig pa dang 'dod snam pha gu rnams kyi thig 'phred du yod pa de dag phyi'o// tshangs thig rnams ma phyis pa gal che'o// de nas thig skud rin po che'i snod du bzhag la/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs la thig skud bsdu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bur las thig gi steng du lha gnas so sor dri bzang byugs la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs lha rang rang gi sngags kyi gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi pa dang*/ lha gnas gzhan rnams su dri thig zlum skor re bya/ 'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bdud rtsi lngas ni kun tu byug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnams su// tsan+dan sogs pa'i gru bzhi bya// phal pa yi ni gnas rnams su| |so sor zlum po byas nas ni// zhes pa'i don no// slar yang rang gi sngags kyi dri thig steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sa ra ha dang*/ dā ri ka pa dang*/ don yod zhabs rnams kyis lha rang rang gi sngags kyi dri thig gi steng du me tog 'god par bshad cing*/

don yod zhabs rnams kyis tshom bu de nyid gdan du bshad kyi tshom bu lha bskyed pa min no// zhes bshad pa'i don no// de'i mthar lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa byung na rab/ ma byung yang ci 'byor ba mchod phreng ltar bshams la/ rang kha maṇ+ḍal la phyogs pas bdag gi mchod pa sogs sgrub mchod kyi skabs 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas la thun bsdus shing skad cig ma'i he ru kar gsal bas/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs la dum bu gcig tu gyur/ ces pa nas de gnyis kyi bar du gzhi dus zhes pa dor nas/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dang aṃ sngon po 'bar zhing 'dzegs pas zhes dang*/ rgyu'i he ru ka zhes pa'i mal du bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje zhes bcug nas sgeg cing bzhad pa'i tshul gyis sgo bzhi bsrung ba'o// zhes pa'i bar ma gtogs nam mkha' nā da 'jug pa yang yab yum 'od du zhu ba dang*/ slar zhu ba glus bskul sogs ni maṇ+ḍal bskyed pa la byed mi dgos shing bdag bskyed kho na la'o// de nas yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa lha mo bcu bdun gyi zhes pa nas/ wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gi bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgoms nas/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying kha nas gau rī sogs lha mo bzhi spros nas nam mkhar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams maṇ+ḍal gyi dam tshig pa la 'gugs pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ mnyes par byas/

bha wa bha dras/ lha'i 'khor lo skad cig gis bskyed nas nam mkhar gnas pa dang gcig tu bsre bar gsungs pa'i don no/ /oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs sngags bzhi po rgya dang bcas pa brjod la/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga zhes pa nas/ bum pa'i chus lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur gyi bar dang*/ de nas gsang dbang sogs chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang gau rī puk+ka sī rnams la zhes pa nas/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas mchod phreng ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mchod bstod byas la/ slar sta gon gyi lha maṇ+ḍal du bzhugs pa de dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems la dmigs nas mar me mdzad bzang pos/ slar yang 'khor 'das mchod nas ni// zhes pa'i don no// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas| shapada'i bar brjod la/ rdor dril dang spos ring thogs pus mo btsugs te lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur par mos la/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud| |gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can/ spyi rgyud las byung*/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung mchog /bdag med ma dang yang bdag sbyor// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro dang*// rig pa'i lha rnams rdzu 'phrul ldan// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol| |slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bdag nyid kye yi rdo rje can// dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni// ji ltar nus bzhin nyer spyod pas// nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni// nye bar 'byon par mdzad du gsol| |zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas legs par gnang bar bsam mo//

lha sta gon 'di bum pa sta gon gyi rjes su phyag na rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas gsungs shing*/ mar me mdzad bzang pos 'di ltar bzhed pa lugs 'di gnyis gang bde bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gser ram/ zangs sam/ dngul las byas pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa lto ba'i thad kar sor nyi shu/ 'khor yug tu mtho lnga/ dpangs sor brgyad/ mchu 'phyangs pa sor gnyis dang ldan pa/ bum pa gzhan rnams che chung ran pa rab lha grangs dang mnyam pa ma byung na bshad ma thag pa'i rnam rgyal dang*/ las bum tshad gang yang rung ba ste| zung 'jug gsal ba las/ bum pa de dag nang na ni// rnam rgyal mtshan nyid ldan par bya// sor mo brgyad kyi tshad kyi ni// mgrin pa mtho zhing rnam par mdzes// lto ba'i rgyar ni mtho lnga'o// gal te 'di las tshad zhan na// yon bdag bde bar 'gyur ma yin// nog pa rnam par spang ba dang*// btsa' ba dor zhing ma 'byor ba// bug pa rnam par spang ba dang*// de bzhin gas pa med par bzung*// zhes rnam rgyal la de ltar dgos pa gsungs so// bum pa gzhan rnams la'ang ma nges par bzhed pa'o| | gnyis ka btsa' ba dang nog pa zhabs stegs 'byar ba sogs yo gas 'khyog bug ral ba sogs med pa/ mchu 'phyangs shing mgrin pa ring la gsus pa che ba dang nag po med pa rgyu rang bzhin gyis dkar na des chog la/ min na sa dkar dang ha shig la sogs pas dkar por bsgyur ba la/ rnam rgyal gyi lto ba'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams su stod kyi char pad zlar lha mo brgyad kyi phyag mtshan nam sa bon/ bar gyi cha la phyogs bzhir pad zla la rol cha ma bzhi'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan/ 'og gi cha la phyogs bzhir pad zla la sgo ma bzhi'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan bkod cing*/ rnam rgyal gyi shar ngos gau rī'i mtshan ma'i steng pad nyi'i gdan la gtso bo yab yum gyi g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar sa bon bris pa dang*/ las bum la lto ba'i phyi ngos kyi mdun du pad zlar thod pa'i nang du sbrul gyi lto bar ghaṃ bris pa la mgul chings ni dar ram ras mdog gang yang rung ba la zung gi rnam rgyal la mgul ze prog lnga pa dang*/

las bum la mgul chings gcig kha dog gang rung gi mgul ze prog gsum pas bcings la hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar po bdun gyis mgul chings dkri zhing*| srad bu des mgul chings 'ching bar bi bhu tas bshad pa dang*/ klu'i dbyangs kyis/ gos ni dkar po chen po yis// bum pa'i mgrin pa bcing bar bya// gos kyi steng du srad bu dag /dkar po cho ga mkhas pas dgod// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes 'brangs so// oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa ra ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ bhan+dha hūm̐/ brjod/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar la sngags bzlas pas brab/ bgegs bskrad la/ chu gtsang dri bzang gi sbags pas sum gnyis bkang zhing*/ dā ri ka pas/ bsang bdug bgegs bskrad sngon 'gro bas// dri zhim pa yi chus bkang ste// zhes gsungs pa'i dgang ba'i chu ni/ nyin mo 'byung gnas kyis/ rta bong bus ma bsgrod pa'i chu blangs la snod gzhan dang ma reg pa'i srog chags med pa'i dri bzang dang 'dres pas dgang bar bshad cing*/ chu la 'o ma dang chang bsre ba sa ra has bshad do// oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ lha'i chu gaṅgā drangs te bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur zhes mos la/ gser/ dngul/ byi ru/ mu tig /mu men te rin po che lnga/ til/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras te 'bru lnga/ sle tres/ dbang lag /shu dag dkar po/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ste sman lnga/ ga pur/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gla rtsi ste dri lnga/ til/ mar/ lan tshwa/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga yang blugs/ yal 'dab dang ldan pa'i 'o ma can gyi shing gis kha brgyan la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las// kha ni shing lo gsar pas dgang*/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyi rgyud las/ ldum bu bzang po dang ni shing gis kha brgyan par gsungs so// ye shes rdo rje'i 'grel pa las/ mgul chings la lci bas brlan pa'i steng du/ rtsa dūrba nyag ma bdun bgegs la sogs pa mi 'jug pa'i don du 'dzugs par bshad pa ltar yin no//

de'i steng du mchod yon gyi ched du dung chos kyi nang du dri bzang dang bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i chur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥhūm̐/ bdun bzlas pas bdud rtsi'i chur mos la rnam rgyal gyi steng du bzhag /de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba dang srad bu kha dog lnga ldan btags la rang gi mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa rang gi g.yas dang*/ las bum g.yon du bzhag pa'i bum pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod na/ rnam rgyal dbus dang bum pa gzhan rnams lha bskyed pa ltar phyogs mtshams su bkod/ de gnyis gang byed kyi mdun du mchod phreng nas 'byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bsham mo// de nas bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings bcings shing dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis sam brgyad las rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang*/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ru// lha yi 'khor lo rdzogs par yang*// skad cig gis ni bsam par bya// gzhan du 'khor los rjes 'brang ba// rigs dang bcas pa bsam par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams 'dab ma brgyad la sna tshogs pad+ma re re/ de dag gi phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad la sna tshogs pad+ma re re las dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du| phung po'i bdud tshangs pa ser po zhes pa nas sgeg cing bzhad pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa zhes pa ma gtogs sgo bzhi bsrung ba zhes mi brjod cing*/ rol cha ma bzhi bskyed pa'i tshe lha rnams zur bzhi zhes mi brjod par mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyi phyi rol gyi mtshams bzhi'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi zla'i bar gyi thig le zhes dang*/

sgo ma bzhi'i tshe de dag gi phyogs bzhi'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng gi nyi zla'i bar gyi thig le zhes dang*/ shar sgo zhes pa'i mal du shar du stag gdong ma zhes dang*/ lho nub byang du yang 'gres te brjod/ gzhan yang lha sta gon ltar sgeg cing bzhad pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar du bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum mtshan rnams sna tshogs pad nyi dang sna tshogs pad zla bcu bdun gyi steng du lha rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i lha so so'i g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum lha mo bcu drug dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur ces dang*/ las bum gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ghaṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i gdan la thod pa rkang mar gyis gang ba'i nang du sbrul ghaṃ yig gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las ghasma rī ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang pos rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa sbrul gyis mtshan pa/ gnyis pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon dang pos dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dang*/ gnyis pas rin po che 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum gdang mig tu bsgrad pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'i skra mtshams su thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas spras pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bum mtshan ghaṃ dang thod pa sbrul sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las ghasma rī sku mdog phyag mtshan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ de nas yab kyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes pa nas/ bum pa'i chus lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs sngar ltar dang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang*/

gau rī puk+ka sī zhes pa nas/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar lha sta gon ltar dang*/ las bum gyi lha la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ 'bul tshig mchod phreng ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bas mchod la/ bstod pa yang mchod phreng du yod pa gnyis gang rung gis bstod cing*/ las bum gyi lha la// chos nyid zhi ba'i dbyings las khro mor bzhengs// ljang nag zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs// phyag bzhis sbrul sogs phyag mtshan 'bar ba thogs// g.yon brkyang gar gyis bgegs tshogs 'joms la bstod// ces bstod la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes dril bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung la/ g.yon pas gzung thag gi sne mo 'dzin cing g.yas pas phreng ba bzung ba grub chen nyin mo'i 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa'o// rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng thon gzung thag la 'khril te song ba/ bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad re dang*/ nye snying dang sa bon rtsa sngags rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar ci nus bzla zhing*/ bum pa'i chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas gzung thag rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa las bum gyi steng du bzhag la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya sogs bzlas/ gtso bum dang las bum thun mong du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen pos zhu ba byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bum mtshan lhar gyur pa rnams kyang slar bum mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/

ces mos/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi dung chos kyi chu la dmigs te/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan bdun dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun bzlas la rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi dung chos kyi chu de rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba de rnams dang las bum gyi lha la mchod yon du phul bar dmigs nas/ dang po rnam rgyal dang de nas las bum gyi nang du sbrengs shing*/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās phul/ las sngags bzlas pas me tog dkar po gsum gsum yang bum pa gnyis la phul nas spos kyis bdug /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ las bum gyi lhas ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'am/ rab gnas kyi bya ba'am/ dbang gi las sam/ sbyin sreg gi las ma rdzogs pa de srid kyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig |ces phrin las bcol/ bod kyi bla ma kha cig gis gtso bum la rgyal ba'i bum pa zhes dang*/ steng gi dung chos la rnam rgyal zhes brjod cing lha bskyed pa'i tshe yang dung chos kyi nang du bskyed nas zhu ba'i skabs dung chos kyi chu bum chur bsre ba dag byed pa ltar 'dug pas khyed kyis de de ltar lha dung chos su bskyed par rigs na bum mtshan yang dung chos la 'bri dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ dung chos kyi steng du mchod yon gzhan zhig kyang 'jog dgos pa'i phyir de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ steng gi dung chos ni bdud rtsi lnga chang ngam chur sbyangs pa dag mchod yon du dmigs nas 'bul dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ bum pa'i steng du dri zhim po'i chus bkang ba'i dung ngam/ thod pa'am/ thod pa'i kham phor 'jog pa ni bum pa la mchod yon phul ba'i snod du bshad de/ lwa ba pas/ de'i steng du mchod yon gyi snod dri zhim po'i chu me tog dkar po dang bcas pa bzhag ste/ de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/

zhes dang*/ me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon bum par phul nas/ zhes gsungs so// de nas chu'i bskyed chog ni/ u da ka de'i yi ge gsum lan bdun pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas rdo rje rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du sems pa phreng bar gsungs pa'i don no// bum pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod/ rnam rgyal du gtso bo yab yum bskyed dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ bum pa gzhan rnams la lha mo re re bskyed cing*/ bum mtshan yang bum pa re re la lha re bri bar shes par bya'o// bzhi pa la/ kun slong bcos pa/ nang dbang bskur ba/ gsol gdab/ mos pa bzhin du bcug pa/ sdom pa bsgrags shing bzung ba/ byin rlabs/ so shing dor ba/ khyor chu sbyin pa/ rmi lam brtag pa/ srung ba gdags pa/ spro ba bskyed pa ste slob ma sta gon chos bcu gcig las/ dang po ni/ lha'i tshom bu dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pa sta gon la mkho ba'i yo byad rdzas rnams 'du byas la bshams pa yol bas bcad/ slob dpon mdun du rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ las bum sogs bshams la slob ma

tshad ldan/ gsum nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar la sogs pa zung du ma gyur pa rnam snang mngon byang las/ slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa// de ni dkon mchog gsum la dad// zab mo yid bzhin blo dang ldan// spro ba che zhing tshul khrims ldan// bzod pa ldan zhing ser sna med// dpal la yi dam bsten pa ni| |bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung*// dpyad mi dgos par bzung bar bya// zhes dang*/ spyi rgyud las/ mdor na slob ma phan tshun du// nang mi gshin pa mi bzung ngo*// gcig la gcig ni sems bzang zhing*| |zhi dul bla ma la phan pa// zhes gsungs so// las bum gyi chus khrus byas nas sngags dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis mdun du 'khod cing me tog bzung nas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ kun slong bcos pa 'di skad brjod/ spyi rgyud kyi gzhung phyed bcas bzhi brgya las/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// 'jig rten 'dir ni don gnyer ba// dkyil 'khor dag tu 'jug bya min// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// dad pa mang du byed pa yis// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa rnams// 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'grub// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer na// 'jig rten 'di 'bras shugs kyis 'grub// ces brjod cing don bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma slar slob ma rjes bzung bya ba'i cho ga byed pa'i slob ma rnams sta gon ji ltar bya ba ni/ spyi rgyud las/ slob ma yongs su bzung ba gang*// sta gon bgyi tshe med na ni// de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas su// ji skad bshad pa'i las rnams bya// slob ma yongs su bzung ba gang*// gal te rkyen 'ga' zhig gis ni// der ni 'ongs par ma gyur na// gzhan dag de yi rkyen par gzhug

/ces pa'ang gsungs so// rnams rang gi zhal du bcug sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon pa yum gyi pad+mar bab dgyes pa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs shing rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar bab pas he ru ka de pad+ma nas byung dkyil 'khor shar sgor 'khod par gyur/ dmigs pa ni/ slob mas kyang mnyam por sgom byed par gsal bar ma gsungs/ slob dpon rang gis byas pa nyid kyis chog pa 'dra ste slob ma re re bzhin dmigs pa gsal bar bya'o// ces mos/ gsum pa ni/ slob mas slob dpon la cir mos bgyis pa rdo rje tha mi dad par mos te thal mo sbyar bas/ yon tan rgya mtsho mthu yis ni// zhes pa nas// de bas mgon po brtse bar mdzod// 'di lan gsum bskyar ba mar me mdzad bzang pos gsungs so// bar dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa| bu tshur shog cig theg chen po// kho bo tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// gang gi shākya seng ge sogs// mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde// mi bzad chen po stobs chen 'joms// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces dang*/ de dag gi don bshad de sngags la mos pa brtan po 'dzin tu 'jug go// lnga pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ klu dbyangs dang*/ mi thub zla ba dang*/ dā ri ka pa dang*| phreng ba sogs kyi dgongs pa sngags sdom bsgrags bzung gnyis ka skabs 'dir byed dgos par bshad pa ltar/

sangs rgyas chos tshogs la ni skyabs su song na sangs rgyas dag pa'i rigs te sdom pa brtan por 'gyur| |rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bzung zhing bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam 'di ni rdo rje dag pa'i rigs// nyin mtshan kun tu sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin pa de ni rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig ste| |phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum gyi dam chos 'dzin pa pad+ma'i rigs su nges par brjod/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa nyid du bzung bar byas na las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig rnam dang ldan// mchod pa'i las bgyid de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi la ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba rab tu grags// gang tshe nyams gyur kha na ma tho sbom po zhes bya srog chags yang ni gsad mi bya// ma byin mi blang 'dod log mi spyad rdzun smra spong zhing phung krol rtsa ba chang yang spong*// sems can 'dul phyir tsam ni ma gtogs bya ba ma yin thams cad spong zhing bla ma nye bar bsten par bya/ mi dge bcu po spangs theg dman lam ni spang bar bya zhing*/ sems can gyi don la rgyab phyogs mi bya gzhan don bgyid/ 'khor ba dag kyang spang bar mi bya rtag tu mya ngan 'das pa la mi chags/ lha dang lha min gsang ba pa dag khyod kyis brnyas par bya ba min/ phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha dang ni mtshan ma la sogs khyod kyis nam yang 'gom par bya ba ma yin no// 'di rnams la ni dam tshig ces brjod do// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya yi rjes mthun sdom pa rgya chen rnams/ gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad kyi gsang sngags dngos grub ma lus pa rnams dam tshig de nyid la rag las pa'o// zhes dang*/ de dag gi don rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rnam bzhag bshad la de dag bsrung bar khas blangs shing gzung ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba dbang gi skabs ltar gsum brjod du gzhug go| |drug pa ni/

de nas slob ma skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lte bar āḥlas pad+ma'i lte bar āḥyig gis mtshan pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ ces mos la g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi srin mdzub brkyangs pas dri'i chus de dag gnas de dag tu thig le bya zhing*| hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ brjod/ sgom pa dang*/ reg pa dang*/ brjod pa dang de gsum mas rim nas byed cing*/ 'bru gsum las/ mtshan ma gsum gyi yi ges mtshan par bsgom pa ni mar me mdzad bzang po'i bzhed pa'o// de nas las kyi rdo rjes nyer spyod lnga slob ma'i mdun du phul zhing*/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod lnga 'bul lo// mchod pa rnams las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis ster ba mar me mdzad pos bzhed cing*/ mchod pa rang sngags kyis ster ba rat+na rak+ṣis bshad do// bdun pa ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ so shing bi shwa dha sogs dgos kyang bod du mi rnyed pas 'o ma can gyis chog par klu dbyangs kyis bshad do// phra sbom 'khyog pa gsum gyi skyon med par rtse mor me tog bcings pa/ dri bzang gis chus bkrus/ spos kyis bdug nas/ slob dpon byang du phyogs pas las sngags bzlas te/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes slob ma'ang byang du phyogs pa la gtad nas/ dri bzang dang*/ ba'i chu rnam lnga byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhi pa'i steng du phyogs mtshams dbus mi 'chol ba'i tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du/ slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā/ zhes brjod cing mig gyen du bltas la ltos pa med par dor du bcug la/ rtse mo gyen du bstan na rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub dang*/ de bzhin 'og tu bstan na sa spyod dang*/ slob dpon la bstan na mchog gi dang*/ shar du zhi ba dang*/

lhor rgyas pa dang*/ nub tu bstan na dbang dang*/ byang du bstan na drag po'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med do// zhes slob ma re re bzhin brda sprad do// brgyad pa ni/ chu gtsang ma dri bzang sogs kyis ma sbags pa thogs te/ baṃ las byung ba'i chur gyur par mos la baṃ bzlas pas khyor bar byin zhing kha bshal la dor bcug go/ khyor chu'i sngon du bshal chu gtong ba phreng ba'i dgongs pa'o// de nas las sngags mang du bzlas chu khyor ba gsum blug cing khyor chu 'di lag mthil g.yon du ster dgos pa 'jigs byed lhas bshad do// oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥdharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod slob mas kyang de lan gsum 'thung bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam mo// dgu pa ni/ rtse mo ma nyams pa'i ku sha mang nyung gnyis byas la/ hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas skyes par mos la/ nyung ba dhīḥdang mang ba hūm̐ gnyis ka las sngags bzlas te/ mang ba stan dang nyung ba sngas kyi don du/ sdom 'byung las/ dhīḥyig gi ni sngags bzlas pa// ku sha de la rab sbyin bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ hūm̐ las byung ba stan dang*/ dhīḥlas byung ba sngas kyi don du bshad cing*/ sbyin pa'i tshe bla ma kha cig gis/ che ba g.yas dang chung ba g.yon du ster bar byed kyang*/ dam tshig rdo rjes/ gnyis ka lag pa g.yon du ster bar bzhed pa de ltar bya'o// oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ zhes brjod la sbyin/ 'di bkra shis pa dang rmi lam mi 'khrul ba'i phyir yin par bid+yā pa tas bshad do// ku sha'i sngas stan la mgo shar dang glo g.yas sa la phyogs te dkon mchog gsum dang rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba btab ste/ nyal nas rmi lam brtags la bzang ngan ji ltar byung yang nangs par rdo rje slob dpon la legs par smros shig ces brjod do// bcu pa ni/

gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu dmar po la slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa zhig sum lteb du bsgrims nas rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab la/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i srung skud du gyur par mos la sngags bzlas te pho'i dpung pa g.yon dang mo'i dpung pa g.yas la rnam snang mngon byang las/ dpung pa g.yon dang*/ sgyu dra las/ g.yas su 'ching bar bshad la/ klu dbyangs dang*/ lwa ba pa dang*/ mi thub zla ba sogs mang pos g.yas la 'ching bar bshad la/ rgyud rdor phreng las/ khru gang sor bzhi'i skud pa rdo rje gsum gyi mdud pa can dpung pa g.yon la lan gsum dkri bar bshad do| |skyes pa dang bud med kyi sgo nas g.yas g.yon bye ba dang*/ mdud mtshams su ji ltar bya ba sogs bod rnams kyis byed pa ni/ dkyil chog tu mi snang ngo*// skud pa 'khel ba ni bu mos bya bar klu dbyangs kyis bshad do// oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ zhes btags la las bum gyi kha rgyan gyi chu dang rdo rje rgya gram mdud pa la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā rak+ṣa/ zhes rgyas gdab bo// bcu gcig pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid// u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung*// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul byung ba// de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ 'di yan gyis gsang sngags 'byung bar dkon pa bstan/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru| |sdig pa gang zhig sngon byas pa// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos| |skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ 'di yan gyis sngags bzla zhing sgom pa mthu che bar bstan/

/spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyis// blo gros shin tu dri med na// de rnams kyi ni sdug bsngal kun// 'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag zhi/ 'di yan gyi sngags la dad pa mthu che bar bstan/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed| |gang gis khyod rnams rgyal ba kun// bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyi// bstan 'di kun la yongs su bzung*// gnas pa skye bar gyur pa ni// de yis khyed rnams theg chen la| |legs par skye ba nyid du gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// gang der khyod rnams 'gro 'gyur bas// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ 'di yan gyis phan yon ni ci rigs pa bsdoms te bstan/ /zhes pas don bkrol te bshad la spro ba bskyed/ de nas slob ma las sngags bzlas pas bsrungs shing slob ma la las sngags byin la bzlar bcug ste/ sngar bshad pa'i rmi lam gyi cho gas nyal du bcug la nangs par rmi lam bzang ngan dris nas bzang na spro ba bskyed cing*/ ngan na las sngags bzlas te gzhom zhing des kyang ma zhi na sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i sbyor bas bzlog pa'i thabs bya'o// 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las// dang po'i thun gyi rmi lam gang*// bad kan las byung shes par bya// gnyis par gang byung mkhris pa ste// 'jig rten la yod smad pa yin// gsum par rlung byung shes pa de// bzhi pa bden par 'byung ba yin// zhes pas brtag cing*// ngan pa'i bzlog thabs/ phreng bar/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bshad cing*/ mar me mdzad bzang pos/ bgegs mthar byed kyis bsrung bar bshad la/ klu dbyangs kyis/ bdag med pa'i don bsam pas bsrung ba dang*/ spyi rgyud las/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang*// dā ri ka pas/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis zlog par bshad pas/ 'di rnams ni slob ma la rmi ltas ngan pa byung ba bzlog pa'i thabs so// gal te slob dpon gyi rmi ltas ngan na bzlog pa'i thabs/

srung 'khor/ bzlas pa/ go cha/ gsol ba gdab pa/ lha'i nga rgyal/ sbyin sreg ste bzlog thabs bdun/ dā ri ka pas bshad pa ltar nan tan bya'o// de nas sta gon gyi lha rnams la mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mchod cing bstod pa byas la/ lag gnyis rdor dril thogs pa'i rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyangs pa'i rtse ma gshibs pa kha 'og tu phyogs pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+rat+tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ 'dir lha rnams nam mkhar 'degs pa'ang*/ lwa ba pa sogs kyis gsol btab zin ma thag dang*/ dā ri ka pas phyi nang snga bar dang*/ phreng bar skabs 'dir 'degs pa dang*/ spyi rgyud las gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ sa ra has snying khar sdud pa sogs mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir phreng ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/ zhes mos la/ lha sta gon gyi dri'i thig le tshom bu mchod pa sogs dang*/ slob ma sta gon gyi rdzas bshams pa rnams bsdus la/ bum pa dben pa 'tshe ba med sar mchod pa dang bcas bzhugs su gsol/ dngos gzhi la bzhi/ dkyil 'khor gyi las rim sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gsum| ye thig gdab pa/ tshon bkye ba/ bum pa dgod cing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa'o// dang po thig skud las thig gi skabs su bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha dog lngar bsgyur/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sdom 'byung las/ srad bu tshan pa lnga'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin la/ ye shes re re la ye shes bzhi bzhi ste rjes su 'gro ba'i ched du sa bon re re las/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spro zhing bsdu ba'i phyir re re la'ang lnga lnga ste/ nyer lnga so sor bsgril bas thig skud lnga 'chos dgos par bshad do// bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang po'i chus sbags pa rin po che'i snod du bzhag la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig skud rnams hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā rnams las thig skud sngon po mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje/ dkar po rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje/ ser po rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje/ dmar po 'od dpag med dgyes pa rdo rje/ ljang gu don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud par gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhā bzlas la/ slar yang slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ slob ma skad cig gis ghasma rīr gyur par mos la/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ zhes brjod cing sngon nas rim par bskyed pa'i go rim ltar thig skud lnga'i sne mo sor sor gtad/ slob mas kyang sngags 'bru lnga brjod cing rim gyis so so nas bslangs pa'i lte ba'i thad du/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i rtse mo nas mthe bong gi rtsa ba'i bar du sngon po mdzub mo'i rtse mor bzhag cing*/ gzhan bzhi po yang go rim ltar bskyed pa'i go rim ltar mthe bong gi rtsa ba'i bar du bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis kyang dril bu dang bcas pas de bzhin bzung la/ nam mkha'i lha dang rigs lnga'i thugs kar/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhā las grub pa'i ye shes kyi thig skud 'od lnga'i rang bzhin can du gyur ces mos nas/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra sū traṃ me pra yats+tsha ma hā maṇ+ḍal sū tra na ya hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen por thig gdab pa'i phyir rdo rje'i thig bdag la stsol cig

/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du ak+ṣo'i gnas su/ sha shwa ta/ rat+na saṃ bha wa/ a mi tā bha/ a mo gha sid+dhi zhes bcug ste rigs lnga la gsol ba btab ste/ rang gi mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi zla ser por gyur/ oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod/ rdzi ma myur du rdeb cing 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus ye shes kyi thig skud rigs lnga'i kha dog can gyi sa bon lnga'i yi ge rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas spyan drangs/ thig skud so so la thim par gyur ces mos la/ sa ra ha dang*/ nag po spyod pas/ lha spyan drangs pa la 'jug /lwa pa dang*/ mar me mdzad bzang pos thig skud spyan drangs nas bstim par bzhed do// oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā chos thams cad thig skud rjes su son pa/ sarba dharmaḥpa ram+ba ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa chos thams cad phan tshun gyi rjes su zhugs pa/ sarba dharmaḥ.a d+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos thams cad shin tu rjes su zhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing dang po lnga dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ chos kun ngo bo nyid kyi ni// srad bu phan tshun sgril bar bya// zhes pa'i don/ mthar gcig tu dril ba cung zad dril la tshad ldan byas la rin po che'i snod du bzhag la/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las/ yi ge gsum chud pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ yi ge gsum gyi nang du chud par byas pas zhes dang*/ dgyes rdor rim gyi cho ga las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum mtha' gnyis dang dbus su bstod pa zhes pa'i don/ thig skud rtse mo gnyis dang dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par mos la/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla ser po'i rang bzhin can du gyur zhes mos shing rdo rje'i lta bas bltas la/ oṃ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭa ma ṭa zhes brtan par byas la/ las sngags bzlas nas bdud rtsi lnga'i chu dang yungs kar dri bzang gi chus bran/ g.yas rdo rje dang lag pas ye thig la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐ brjod la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas bum pa gnyis kyi chu dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir gtor la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtsang bar byas shing*/ nam mkha'i khams su dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /zhes pa nas/ shapada'i bar mchod la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gyis bstod cing*/ slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje dang slob ma ghasma rīr gsal bar/ de nas slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du bsgrengs nas/ slob dpon gyis/ phyogs thams cad du rang bzhin med pas mnyam pa nyid do// mig gnyis dzaḥlas skyes pa'i nyi zla ser po 'od 'phro ba can du gyur| sdom 'byung gi dgongs pa/ ces mos la/ slob dpon gyis g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi lte ba'i thad du ye thig bzung la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur dag /lte bar bzhag ste gzung bar bya// de yi 'og tu ci bder bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥbarjod cing*/ slar dz+dza gsum brjod pas ye thig lnga po cung zad dril ba de ma zhig par sne mo slob ma la gtad de slob mas kyang dz+dzaḥgasum brjod pas g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis blangs te lte bar bzung la/ de nas slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas mtheb mdzub kyis stegs bu'i steng phyogs kyi nam mkhar thig btab la se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ brjod la/ thig gi sgras/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ dus yin de phyir 'dir byon zhig 'di phreng bar gsung zhing*/ mar me mdzad bzang po dang*/ lwa pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa dang*/ sa ra ha la sogs pa mang po'i bzhed la/ 'di thig skud kyi sgra yin pas ngag tu ma brjod kyang chog / ces bskul bas nam mkhas khyab pa'i sangs rgyas rnams byon te thig skud la thim par gyur/

ces mos nas sdod pa dang rkang stabs sogs sngar bzhin shar nub kyi tshangs thig dang po btab la/ slar yang thig gi sgras sangs rgyas rnams byon te thig skud la thim/ de las ye shes lnga'i ngo bo srad bu kha dog lnga pa'i thig skud re chad nas stegs bur gnas pa'i las thig la thim par gyur ces mos nas/ slob dpon gyi rkang mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje 'od 'phro ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re re gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ sngar las thig dus 'dug stangs phreng ba las/ bar snang la thig 'debs pa'i dus su slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ g.yas sa la 'dzugs par bshad pa/ slob ma de las ldog par bya'o// skor phyogs rkang stabs sogs ma nor bar stegs bu'i thig le thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la thig rdzogs par gdab cing*/ thig rdzogs par gdab mi nus na thig chen brgyad dang rtsa thig zlum thig rnams gdab pa'i tshul bya'o// zlum thig rnams skor ba'i tshe lte bar phur bu gdab pa sogs kyi dus ye thig bstims zin pa'i stegs bu'i sne thig la 'gom yug gi nyes dmigs byung na zlum thig gi tshe thig chen brgyad kyi ye thig /oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ gis nam mkhar bteg la zlum thig bskor zin nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim mo// ye thig gdab pa'i tshad tshangs thig gnyis 'od phreng nas 'od phreng gi bar dang*/ zur thig gnyis mda' yab kyi rtse nas mda' yab kyi rtse'i bar dang*/ rtsa thig rnams 'khor lo'i tshad du gdab par phreng ba las gsungs shing*/ ye thig 'debs pa'i tshe bla mas rdor dril 'dzin dgos pa lwa pas bshad do// de nas thig skud rin po che'i snod du bzhag la mchod cing*/ a kā ro gsum gyis gtor ma phul la bstod/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur par dmigs nas ye thig gi srad bu bsdu'o// ye thig gi skabs pra brtag pa ni/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung*| srad bu chad na slob dpon 'chi/ */ring thung cher na nad kyis thebs// phyogs 'khrugs pa yis slob ma dang*// slob dpon la yang nyes par gsungs// de bas thams cad nan tan du// mkhas pas legs par thig gdab bo// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ tshon sngon dkar ser dmar ljang ba rnams/ tshon gyi rgyu ni/ rab kyis shel spug dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ margad dang*/ in+d+ra nī la'am/ yang na/ mu tig dang*/ gser dang*/ byu ru dang*/ mu men rnams la bya'o// 'bring gis 'bras dkar mo ma grug pa rin po che rnams kyis kha bsgyur ba la bya'o// tha mas me tog gam/ so ba'i phye ma'am/ rus pa'i phye ma'am/ rdo thal dkar po kha bsgyur ba rin po ches sbags pa la bya'o// de rnams thams cad kyang 'du bya ba bzang po rnams zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'di rnams sdom 'byung spyi rgyud sogs las bshad do// snod so sor bzhag pa'i sngon po la hūm̐/ dkar po la oṃ/ ser po swā/ dmar po āḥ ljang khu hā rnams bris pa la sngon po dbus dang*/ dkar po shar/ ser po lho/ dmar po nub/ ljang gu byang du bkod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon rnams hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā rnams las/ tshon sngon po mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje/ dkar po rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje/ ser po rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje/ dmar po 'od dpag med dgyes pa rdo rje/ ljang gu don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa gsal bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ nam mkha'i dkyil gyi lha dang rigs lnga'i thugs kar hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā las grub pa'i ye shes kyi tshon 'od zer lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi zla so sor gyur/ oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥ

zhes brjod/ rdzi ma myur du rdeb cing 'bar ba'i lta stangs byas la| 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus ye shes kyi tshon rigs lnga'i kha dog can gyi sa bon re rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas spyan drangs/ tshon rnams la thim par gyur pas mos la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ slar yang tshon rnams hī yig gis mtshan par gyur/ bden pa gang gis rdul tshon rnams mang zhing 'di la ni rdul rnams mang zhing zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can la chags pa dang rjes su chags par gyur pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar gyur cig /ces mos la/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ nas/ shapada'i bar mchod la/ stegs bu'i ye thig de nyid/ oṃ be gā kra ma dza ya se nas/ tshon rtsi 'gyed pa'i dus su ni// ye shes thig ni nam mkha' la// rtsa ba'i sngags brjod nas bteg ste// bri pa zin nas 'phags ma bstim// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// hūm̐ gis nam mkhar bteg la dkyil 'khor dbus kyi phur khung tshon sna lngas bkang la dril bu gsil zhing*/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste| gur gyi brgyad pa las/ de la 'dir ni rdul tshon gdab pa'i dam tshig go// chos dbyings 'di ni lhag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol mdzad/ /rgya chen dgyes pa rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya/ /sems can khams ni rab grol mdzad// rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes brjod pas tshon gyi nyes pa bsal lo// tshigs bcad 'di ni tshon gyi nyes pa sel byed yin gyi/ kha cig gi chos dbyings zhes pa'i mal du me long sogs ye shes lnga bcug nas tshon 'gyed pa'i dus brjod pa dag 'dug ste/ de ni legs pa ma yin zhing*/ 'di la chos dbyings ma gtogs ye shes gzhan gyi sham bu mi dgos pa dkyil chog khungs thub mang por 'dug pa bdag rang gis mthong ngo*| |de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug ste kha shar du phyogs pas g.yas rdo rje bzung g.yon khu tshur las mtheb mdzub kyi dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du rtsig pa phyi ngos nas/

rim gyis dkar ser dmar ljang nag po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang*// kun gyi nang rol nag po ru// tshon gyi cha ni rim bzhin gyis// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// zheng du sgo'i nyi shu'i cha dang*/ dpangs mthe'u chung gi tshad/ srid du sor bcu gnyis pa drang por 'then la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ brjod la/ thod pas rin po che'i snod bkab pa'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la mchod bstod bya zhing*/ rtsig pa gzhan du sbrel ran dus kha phye la pra legs nyes brtag /legs na/ e ma hoḥ zhes sems gzengs bstod pa dang*/ ngan na stong pa nyid bsgom/ gzhung du pra brtag pa dngos su ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur la/ rtsig pa lnga po mtho re tsam bris rjes slob dpon gyis ma nus na ri mo mkhan sogs kyis 'bri rung ngo*// de yang bshad ma thag pa las/ sbom na nad bskyed/ phra na nor nyams/ dma' na dngos grub mi 'byung*/ yo na sdug bsngal bskyed/ chad na slob dpon 'chi/ 'dres na slob rgyud 'chad pas bsgrims te bri'o/ / lung las/ sboms su sgo yi nyi shu'i char// re kha yang dag drang bar bya// mnyam zhing drang la ma chad par// ji ltar reg pas phan tshun gyi// bar gyi tshad ni nas brtsams te// 'og dang steng ni ci mdzes kyang*// sbom por bkye ba nad 'byung ngo*// phra mo yid bzhin nor rnams nyams// yon po yis ni rnam par sdang*// chad na bla ma slob dpon 'chi// g.yas skor min par bkye ba ni// tshon rnams phur bus bstab par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yang mtshan nyid dang nges par byas te bri la/ cung zad ma legs kyang de kho na nyid kyi bsam sbyor dang ldan pa la skyon med/ lung las/ tshon 'gyed pa la nyes pa ni// de nyid bsam sbyor med rnams la'o// de nyid bsam sbyor ldan rnams la// sus kyang bar chad bya mi nus// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o//

de nas slob dpon gyis yongs su rdzogs pa 'brir mi nus na/ gzhan gyis kyang bri'o// tshon 'gyed pa ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba ljang khu/ ze'u 'bru ser/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ dbang ldan sngo/ bden bral ljang*/ me rlung ser/ lha rnams sngo/ gong ras mdzes tshon/ mu khyud dkar po la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba/ khyams sgo nang rnams dkar ser dmar ljang*/ ka ba brgyad phyogs mdog /ka rgyan mdzes tshon/ 'dod snam dmar po/ pha gu ser po la rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dra phyed dkar po/ gzhi nag po/ shar bu sngon po la ril ba mgo thur bstan gyi dbyibs/ mda' yab dkar po la pad+ma sna tshogs mdog /sgo'i mun pa khor ma/ sgo khyud du zla phyed rin po che'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rta babs gser ser po/ shar bu sngon po la ril ba mgo thur bstan/ rin po che dmar po la rin po che'i rgyan/ rmig pa ljang gu la de'i dbyibs kyi ri mo/ mun pa nag po/ wa raṇ+ḍa ser po/ de yan bshad ma thag pa dang mtshungs so// gu ṇa ha ri phyogs mdog /dho s+t+wa dang swa rtse phyogs mdog /pad+ma sna tshogs/ 'khor lo ser po/ gdugs dkar po/ ri dwags ser po/ phyi'i khyams ljang skya la rgyan thams cad sgrub thabs kyi 'don cha lta bu/ pad+ma'i ra ba'i lte ba mtshon byed la re kha ljang nag /de'i phyir ze'u 'bru mtshon byed re kha ser po/ pad+ma sna tshogs mdog /gong ras mdzes tshon/ de'i phyir chos 'byung mtshon byed re kha dkar po/ de'i phyir dur khrod kyi gzhi nag po la chu brgyad kyi dbye ba sogs mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar/ de'i phyir rdo ra'i gzhi dkar po rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba/ de'i phyir me ri kha dog lnga ldan g.yas skor du bri ba'o// dur khrod kyi sprin dang ri mchod rten zhing skyong phyogs skyong sogs kyi mdog bri bar 'dod na/ sgam po pa maṅga'i mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje thod pa can lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su dur khrod ji ltar byas pa ltar byas na shin tu legs so// de nas yab yum lha bco brgyad so so'i gdan dang sa bon phyag mtshan rnams ni sgrub thabs ngag 'don ltar lha'i gnas ma 'chol bar byas nas legs par 'bri zhing*/

klu'i blo gros kyis/ ji ltar nus pa'i dkyil 'khor du// sa bon dgod bya yang na ni// mtshan ma'i lha'i gzugs de nyid// lugs ma'am 'du byas 'god par bya// zhes gsungs so// 'dir ma thob pa'i tshon dgos pa rnams ni mdzes tshon bya'o// de ltar legs par bris zin nas/ slob dpon gyis/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye thig rnams thig so sor thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la tshon ma rnams la mchod cing*/ a kā ro gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas bstod la/ badz+ra muḥ tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur ces mos so// gsum pa ni/ sngar sta gon byas pa'i bum pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa/ spos dang rol mos bkur sti dang pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas/ bum mchod rdzas la sogs pa dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo dang*// sil snyan glu yis spyan drangs la// dkyil 'khor gnas su dgod par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin/ bcas pas khyer te dkyil 'khor la g.yas su bskor ba gsum byas la rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i g.yas kyi thad dang*/ las bum shar sgo'i g.yon dang gzhan rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtshan dang chos mthun pa'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams su gnas ma 'chol bar bkod cing*/ bi bhu ti dang*/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas bzhed par 'grel pa 'di kho na nyid ltar gsungs so// bum pa gnyis yin na rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang*/ las bum shar sgo'i g.yon gyi thad kyi me ri'i phyi rol du bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og tu dar gos kyi 'phan gdugs bla re la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dkyil 'khor dang bum pa lha grangs mnyam pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor ba la hūm̐ dang gtso bo'i sngags kyis btab pa la mchod phreng du bshad pa ltar phyogs ma log par bshams/ sa ra has/ de nas me tog spos la sogs// lha yi grangs dang mnyam par 'bul// zhes pa'i don no//

mchod pa'i nang gi phyogs gang bder gtor ma bshams/ gzhan yang dbu rgyan sogs dbang la mkho ba'i yo byad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' 'am slob dpon gyi mdun du mthong ba rgyud pa ltar bshams/ mchod pa gshom pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod kyang bsham mo// nye logs su phyi rol pa'i gtor ma'ang 'du bya zhing dkyil 'khor gyi phyi yol bas bcad la mi mthong bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ rang khrus byas lus spos dri zhim pos byugs/ gtsug tor la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan te/ stan bde bar maṇ+ḍal la kha phyogs pas 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i he ru ka mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ sa ra ha dang*/ dā ri ka pas sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs bsgoms pa'i rjes su mdun bskyed bsgrub par bya'o// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng ba las/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyis sbyang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i don no// 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs la dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i zhes pa nas/ wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bar lha sta gon ltar bsgoms la/ de nas sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod cing bstod pas bstod la/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las gau rī/ tsau rī/ be tā lī/ ghasma rī rnams spros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rnams mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa la/ dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/

bcing ba dang*/ mnyes par byas zhes mos nas/ dā ri ka pas/ bsangs te lha rnams rnam par bsam// nam mkha'i lha rnams bab nas kyang*// ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te// drug pa ro gcig myur bar bya// zhes pa'i don/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ār+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas bya'o// zhag mang du 'brel na gong du bshad ma thag pa'i rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ nas wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ'i bar 'di/ nub dang po la ma gtogs zhag gzhan rnams la mi dgos so// de nas rang dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi dpral bar oṃ dang*/ snying gar hūm̐ gsang gnas kyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las zhes pa nas/ snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po'i sgra zhes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bdag bskyed ltar la shī shī shī zhes pa'i sgras/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs rang gi zhal du zhugs pa/ gsang 'dus le'u bzhi pa las/ dngos sam sgom pa'i rim pa gang rung dang*/ snyoms 'jug sgra yis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rang gi kha nas lus kyi nang du bcug pa zhu nas pad+mar phyung ba na lha'i 'khor lor gyur pa rnams 'phros te de'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo la 'jug go// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thig le'i rnam par yum gyi pad mar phyung ba ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa spros te mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa la dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ mnyes par byas zhes mos la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs sngags bzhi brjod cing phyag rgya byas la/

slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar/ lha sta gon ltar byas la mchod pa sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod phreng ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgyas pas mchod cing*/ bstod pas bstod pa sogs mchod phreng nas 'byung ba ltar phul nas/ lha rnams kyi zhabs la 'jus par mos te lha so so'i snying po tshar re re dang*/ thun mong du yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha dang lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad la skal pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pa gzhan la phan pa rnams mdzad de bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar 'dus thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim par gyur/ ces yab kyi snying po dang*/ nye snying sa bon rnams dang*/ yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying sa bon rnams ci 'grub bzlas la/ yab yum thun mong du rtsa sngags yang bzlas shing*/ mtha' 'khor gyi lha mo so so'i sngags kyang ci 'grub bzla'o// yang ras bris mngon spyod kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi pas kyang*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ma bstan pa'i khungs mang po yod/ yin na/ mchod pa dang bum pa bkod pa sogs thams cad rdul tshon kho na ltar la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur ces mos pa'i bar dang bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom zhing*/ ras bris bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs la dum bu gcig tu gyur/ ces pa nas/ wā si ni badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis bar lha sta gon ltar bsgoms la/ de nas rang dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi dpral bar oṃ snying khar hūm̐ gsang gnas kyi mkha' mi dmigs pa zhes pa nas/

snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po'i sgra zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi rnal 'byor ltar la shī shī shī zhes pa'i sgras/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs rang gi zhal du zhugs/ zhes pa nas ye shes 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i bar rdul tshon mdun bskyed ltar bya'o| |de nas skabs 'dir bum pa bcu bdun nam gnyis/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa zhes pa nas/ ma rdzogs kyi bar du de srid du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig gi bar bum pa sta gon ltar byas la/ slar dung chos de'i nang du rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu ran tsam blugs te rnam rgyal rang gi steng du bkod la bzhag /las bum gyi chu nas cung zad bum rdzas sogs dgos pa'i shes byed kyang*/ mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil mchog las// bum pa lha'i gnas yin te// kha rgyan mgul chings rta babs rgyan// gzung thag thugs rje chen po'i rtags// sman lnga thugs rje'i byang chub sems// 'bru rnams lha'i rang bzhin yin// rin chen lnga ni sku yi 'od// snying po ye shes thugs kyi dbyings// spos lnga tshul khrims yon tan rgyal// zhes grub chen ku ku rā dzas bshad do// gcig 'thor 'thung gi snod du bzhag go// de nas sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho gas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gtor ma phul te/ sgrub grogs shig dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ gzhan rnams phyi rol du'am yang na dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gtor ma phul zin nas/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la phyi rol du 'bul ba ni/ sa ra ha dang mar me mdzad bzhed do// nang du'ang rung ste/

'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pa bshams la sgrub thabs ltar phyogs skyong dang rgyal ba bzang pos/ de nas shar sgo nas phyung ste// dbang po la sogs phyogs bdag kun| |tshig gis nye bar spyan drangs te// zhes pa'i don/ 'byung po la gtor ma phul lo// gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal bya/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod/ 'di legs sbyar la pra we sha ya sogs kyi sngags yin la| bod skad du bsgyur ba 'di dpal mchog las gsungs so// dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba// thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog gi bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyi// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rab tu 'grub par mdzod// ces rang nyid spro ba bskyed cing me tog gi phreng ba zhig lag tu blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa bteg ste nang du song nas lha snam gyi steng du skor ba byed par mos te/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du skor ba byas nas shar sgo nas/ legs sbyar la pa raṃ su kha sogs yin la/ bod skad du bsgyur ba dpal mchog las gsungs/ oṃ/ mchog tu bde ba'i sems can rol par ldan// sgeg pa'i gzugs kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hi hiḥ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gtso bo la mjal rten gyi tshul du me tog phul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang sngar rtsig pa bteg pa'i rmang nas zhugs te slar nang nas sgo dbye ba ni/ sdom 'byung gi dgongs pa yin/ nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas shar nas bzung sgo rnams rim gyis nang nas phye bar mos/ de nas/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi/ zhes brjod de sngar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang rang gis gar byed cing blangs te mgo la bcing bar mos/
