de nas rdo rje'i thal mo spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ pra ṇā men sarba ta thā ga taṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor pa la phyag 'tshal te/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab/ bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i gtso bos slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad nas dbang bskur bar mos shing*/ bdag 'jug gi dus dbang gi tshig slob dpon zhes pa'i mal du gtso bo dang*/ slob ma zhes pa'i mal du rang ngam bdag ces 'don pa brje zhing*/ dbang tshig rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag la brjod pa dang*/ dbang bskur bar mos pa rtse gcig tu byas la/ dngos su bdag nyid kyi dbang tshig brjod cing dbang blangs te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rdzogs par blangs nas/ mar me mdzad bzang po dang*/ sa ra ha dang*/ lwa ba pa la sogs du mas kyang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i dus bzhin tu slob dpon yang 'jug par gsungs shing*/ phreng ba las kyang*/ 'di ni slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de nas slob ma 'jug pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ lag g.yas thal mo snying khar bsgrengs shing g.yon dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i mchod pa dang*/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan med phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// dgyes pa rdo rje bdag grub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// de kho na nyid dang bden pa bsgrags pa lnga ni/ nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che// de bzhin nyid du bdag grub mdzod/ 'di yan de kho na nyid kyi dam tshig gi glu/ /shin tu rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/

'di yan chos nyid kyi dam tshig gi glu/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang chen mchog gi phyag rgya yi// rdo rje chen po gsor ba las| |rdo rje snyems ma bdag grub mdzod/ 'di yan dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i glu/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin// dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog 'di yan de kho na nyid bsgrags pa/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes che// shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa de yi mgon khyod kyis// 'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de nyid de bzhin nyid nges 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog 'di yan chad bden pa bsgrags pa/ /ces gsol ba btab cing 'di ni shan+ti pa dang*/ a bha yas bshad pa yin zhing*/ dpal che mchog dang de'i 'grel pa dang*/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ lwa ba pa sogs kyis dkyil chog rnams su gsal bar 'di nyid gsungs so// 'di lan gsum byed pa ni/ dā ri ka pas bzhed do// bden stobs brjod/ gsum pa la gnyis/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas te zhugs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du zhugs pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis/ yol ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang*/ nang du zhugs pa'o// dang po ni/ sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams la las bum gyi chus khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar te/ yol ba'i phyi rol nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med par mos te/ slob mas/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis// de nyid bla med shes par bya// rdo rje'i dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis// bka' drin che de bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che// ji ltar dpal ldan sems rdo rje// rdo rje chos la bstan pa bzhin// mgon pos bdag la bka' drin gnongs// bcom ldan khyod zhabs pad+ma ni// spangs nas skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// 'khor bar 'gro ba spang ba'i phyir// de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod// ces sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab tu dbye ba gsum pa nas 'byung bas gsol ba btab/

slob dpon gyis/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta anut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gi las sngags bzlas pas smad g.yogs dang*/

'di'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyi dar sogs dmar po'am/ ser po sogs dgos pa lwa ba pas bshad do// yang de nyid bsdus pa las/ dum bu so so la kha dog so sor gsungs pa'i phyir/ dmar ser kho na dgos pa'i nges pa med do// slob ma chas 'jug byed pa 'di/ shan+ti pa dang*/ bha wa bha dra sogs mang pos bzhed do// oṃ badz+ra rak+ta hūm̐ gis stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ gis gtsug tor dang*/ sngags 'dis mig 'ching tshul ni/ lwa ba pas/ slob ma tha ma dang*/ 'bring la ye mi mthong ba dang*/ rab cung zad mthong ba 'ching dgos par bshad do// oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gi las sngags bzla zhing dar dmar pos gdong g.yogs/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba dngos sam/ dar gos me tog gi tshul bcos pa gtad/ las bum gyi chus/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bsangs la/ slob ma dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin pa pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po rnams kyis lus 'od gsal bar byas pas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod par gyur/ 'di shan+ti pa dang*/ nyin mo'i 'byung gnas sogs kyi dgongs pa'o// ces mos/ slob mas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ */zhes sogs kyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la bstsal nas su// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi// de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyi// zhes gsol ba btab/ slar yang sdom pa gzung pa ni/

slob mas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// de ring mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la| |phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// thams cad tu ni rab tu gzung*// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems mchog bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa gsum pa na gsungs pa tshar gsum gyis sdom pa 'dzin tu bcug /de nas slob dpon gyis/ kye zhes bos te/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris pas/ dris lan 'di ni dā ri ka pa dang*/ sa ra ha dang*/ lwa ba pa sogs mang pos bzhed cing*/ mnyam sbyor dkyil chog gnyis su yang 'byung ngo*// slob mas/

skal bzang bde chen gnas la dga'// zhes dang*/ yang bla mas/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes 'dri/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go// zhes lan gdab/ de nas sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i 'di kun snying dang shan+ti pa gnyis kyis/ smon sems dang byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pas 'jug sems skye bar gsungs shing*/ kun snying gis zla ba tshad med pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje stong nyid ngo bor gsungs so// dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro bas mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ dpal mchog las/ de la dang po kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i sngags lan gcig brjod pas sems bskyed du bcug ste/ 'di brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mi 'bral zhing*/ phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du rtogs par bya'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ sngags 'dis sems bskyed dgos pa mar me mdzad bzang po'i zhabs dang*/ lwa ba pa dang*/ sa ra ha dang*/ dā ri ka pa sogs kyis bzhed pas/ sngags 'di ni dkyus su ma lus par brda 'phrod par byas na gsang sngags kyi rten 'brel khyad par can 'grig pa'i dbang bskur ba la bsngags pa shin tu che bar mdzad do// zhes brjod pas slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying khar reg ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod de brtan par byas la gsang bar gdam pa ni/ slob dpon gyi lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas slob ma'i mgor reg ste/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/

khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// gsang bar gdam pa 'di dpal mchog dang mar me mdzad bzang po sogs kyis bshad do// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lwa pas/ shar phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma'i sngags kyis slob ma 'jug ste zhes pa'i don/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ 'dus pa'i bcu drug pa las/ de la yi ge lnga po 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig zhes pa'i don no// zhes slob dpon gyis slob ma yol ba'i nang du khrid de/ slob mas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya/ oṃ ma hā ra ti su dṛ ḍho su to ṣ+ya su kho badz+ra satwa āt+ma sid+dh+ya mi/ zhes slob mas brjod/ slar yang slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ rigs lnga'i nga rgyal bzung la don dran pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bud+dha pū dzopa s+thā nā ya a bhi ṣe kā ya pra warta nā ya/ karma ṇi āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa bai ro tsa na badz+ra rat+na badz+ra dharma badz+ra karma a dhiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa pra warta ya karma ku ru māṃ/ phyag 'tshal ba'i sngags 'di de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu dang po las gsungs so// zhes brjod du bcug /slar yang*/ slob mas shar nas/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra ṇā ya pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba satwa pa ri tra nār+thaṃ āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes slob dpon la phyag bya'o// de nas lha'i dam tshig bsgrags shing dam la bzhag pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzung la/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs te/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi| ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/

khyod kyis kyang dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya yi/ gal te smras na khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ dam bzhag 'di rnams byed pa'i gnas ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su byed par lwa ba pa sogs kyis bshad do// zhes brjod/ slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzhag la dril bu gsil zhing*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yi// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// de nyid bsdus pa las bshad/ ces dang*/ snying khar bzhag la/ tshigs bcad 'di ni lwa ba pas bshad cing*/ 'di lha ye shes pa lus la zhugs pa mi bzhugs pas nyes pa chen po 'byung zhes par dgongs/ oṃ/ de ring dgyes pa rdo rje rang*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod la/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi dung chos kyi chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di don yod zhabs kyis lag tu mna' chu sbyin par bshad cing*/ rtse mo las/ rdo rje sems pa'i mna' yis ni// snying po 'di yis mna' bsgag go// zhes gsungs pa'i don te/ mna' chu blud pa'i dam bzhag ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig spyi'i yin la lhag ma rnams ni khyad par ba'i dam bzhag go// ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed| |dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung*// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes byin la 'thung du gzhug /de nas slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i slob ma'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal dgyes pa rdo rje he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig bgo ba'i tshe/ nges par de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig

/gal te byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod de dam la bzhag/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i dam gzhag 'di ni mar me mdzad kyis dam bca' brtan par bya ba la bshad cing*/ mi thub zla bas/ dad pa nye bar gnas pa la// ci ste 'di ni mi brtan par// dgos phyir bla mas brtag par bya// zhes gsungs/ dam bzhag snga ma dang snga ma rnams kyis dam la bzhag pa de brtan gyi dgos pas bka' gnyan gyi dam bzhag 'di mdzad do// de ltar na mna' chu rtsa ba 'di yan lag gi dam tshig kun sdom zhing*/ gsang slad du phan yon nyes dmigs kyi dam bzhag gsum gyis snod min la gsang ba sgrog pa mi sgrog pa spong ched du rtsa ltung bdun pa bsrung ba la dmigs bsal slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i dam bzhag 'di/ bla ma la brnyas shing bka' las 'das na dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba zhes pa'i phyir nyes dmigs che bar dgongs te/ rtsa ltung dang po bsrung ba la nan che bar mdzad do// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig |dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i ye shes bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po yum dang bcas pa gsal ba'i snying khar/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ mgo bor waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i zla ba la haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i zla ba la āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros thugs sku gsung gi rdo rje rnams spyan drangs so so'i sa bon la thim/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pas sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan zhing 'od 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiḥdamar pos lus 'degs shing dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer gyi tshogs rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pa dang*/

sa bon gsum gyi 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gsal bar gyur/ ces dpon slob gnyis kas mos te/ slob dpon gyis sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying khar bzhag nas/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang*// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// de ring khyod la 'bebs par mdzad// ces brjod la/ gu gul sogs pa'i rdzas kyis bdug cing*/ bdug pa'i rdzas ni bud med kyi 'doms dkris zla mtshan gyis gos pa gtubs la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga byi la'i brun gyis byugs shing*/ gu gul dang bsres pa dag thod phor du bzhag pa ro sol gyi mes bsregs nas bdug pa/ dril bu pas gsungs so| |'di rdzas la brten nas ye shes dbab pa'i thabs so// he badz+ra kro dha dz+nyā na ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiḥ zhes lan brgya'i bar brjod cing*/ sa ra has/ ye shes dbab pa'i spog chog haṃ las snying khar 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yab yum yungs kar tsam zhig bsgoms la/ de'i mkha' gsang bskyod pas 'od zer dmar pos lus kun gang bar bsam la sngags bton nas dbab par bya'o// rnga dung cha lang la sogs pa'i rol mo'i rigs ji snyed pa sbir zhing*/ slob dpon gyis ḍā dril drag tu smin mtshams su bskyod cing dkrol la ye shes dbab/ sku gsung thugs phebs pa'i rtags lus 'dar zhing 'phar ba dang*/ sngon mi shes pa'i saṃskṛ ta'i skad dang tshigs bcad smra ba dang*/ nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba sogs ma byung gi bar bskyar nas phab/ rtags byung tshe de ltar phab nas dge mi dge dri ba ni/ slob ma'i snying ga'i 'od kyi āḥs bskul zhing lce'am zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po'i 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrugs par bsgoms la rdo rje smros shig ces dris pas/ rang gzhan la dge mi dge smra ste 'di med mi rung gi yan lag go// ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshe ring du 'phar na de'i steng du ri rab rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi dbang chen dkyil 'khor rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa yi ge āḥrnam par snang mdzad rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs par bsgoms la zhi bar bya'o// dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sngon du gzhon nu ma sogs la ye shes phab ste dge mi dge dris pa yin na/

rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa bkug nas rang gi snying khar bstim zhing*/ de'i mgor rdo rje bzung la/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiḥmuḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ 'di dbang gi ye shes ches mi mthun/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag cing tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya'o// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas phyogs pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang gi thad kyi kha dog dris te brtag pa ni/ slob ma'i lce la āḥyig dmar po 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba gsal bar gyur/ smros shig rdo rje dge mi dge// khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*| |zhes dris pas/ slob mas/ dkar ser dmar ljang gang mthong smra ba'am/ yang na/ mgon po kha dog sna tshogs mthong*// zhes brjod la/ slob dpon gyis/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po'i las 'grub/ ces so sor brda sprod pa'am yang na phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan/ de nas slob ma'i mthe bong gnyis nas/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje dang bcas pas 'jus nas dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i 'gros kyis skor ba gsum byas te shar sgor bzhag ste/ slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil zhing*/

bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di ni spyi rgyud nas 'byung ngo*// yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di'i dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ji 'dra ba// de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar gtad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid rin po che'i phreng bar mos la thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi dbu la phul ba dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma'i lus gsal zhing sdig pa bkrus par gyur/ ces brjod de/ slob mas/ rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir// rigs pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa to me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ a khaṃ bā'i ra hūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ sngags 'di ni de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs pa klu dbyangs kyis bzhed la/ traṃ gi sngags dgos pa ni/ lwa ba pa dang*/ nyin mo'i 'byung gnas kyis bshad cing*/ don yod zhabs kyis lan gsum 'dor bar bshad/ rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel par/ dbang bskur ba thob nas ni rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa la me tog 'jog par bshad do// dri med 'od kyi lung bstan bzhin rdul tshon la me tog dor bas nyams na sdig tu 'gyur zhing rnam rgyal bum pa'i mtshan ma la dor ba dang*/ sems dge ba la nyes pa med ces pa'i lung gis rdul tshon du dor yang nyes med du gsungs pas gang bder bya'o// zhes brjod cing dor/ slob dpon gyis gtso bo la phog na mchog gi dngos grub/ 'khor rnams la thun mong gi dngos grub/

gzhal yas khang gi nang du tshud tsam la 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ lan gsum bskyar la pho brang du ma tshud na nges par 'chi ba gdon mi za'o// 'di ma shi yang nges par lwa ba pas nges par mi bzung gsungs/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med pas dkyil 'khor du yang lta bar mi dbang ngo*// spyi rgyud las/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas slar 'jug par bshad do// zhes lung bstan/ slar yang me tog gi phreng ba de slob dpon gyis blangs te slob ma'i mgor bcings la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ sdom 'byung gi 'grel par sngags 'di bod skad du tshigs bcad yod cing*/ de nyid bsdus pa las/ de bcings pas sems dpa' chen po bdag gir byas par 'gyur bas 'di 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes pa ni/ dbang gi thog mar me tog gi phreng ba'i dbang sbyin no// de nas slob ma'i snying khar zla ba la hūm̐ dang dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis la oṃ yig 'od zer 'phro bas mtshan par gyur par mos la/ oṃ/ de ring dgyes pa rdo rje rang*// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni 'byed par brtson// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ sngags 'dis 'byed par 'phags pa lha dang*/ lwa ba pa sogs kyis bshad cing*/ nag po spyod pa dang*/ dā ri ka pa sogs kyis mig thur gyis 'byed pa'i tshul bya dgos par bshad do// zhes gdong g.yogs bsal la/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi// rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pa// gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par bgyi/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ tshigs bcad 'di rnams rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud gnyis ka nas gsungs so//

zhes brjod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nas lha so so'i mngon rtogs kyi mtshan tsam gyi lha ngo bstan cing gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dang bcas pa rdzogs par bstan to// skabs 'dir klu dbyangs kyis/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i de kho na nyid ston par gsungs pa ltar| rgyal bzang po dang*/ dza ya se nas kyang bshad la/ 'phags pa lhas/ de mig phye nas phyag byas te// lha yi de nyid bstan par bya// zhes gsungs so// de nas slob mas/ oṃ/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba la'ang gnyis/ dngos gzhi dang*/ spyi'i mtha' rten no// dang po la bzhi/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa rnams so// dang po la gnyis/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dang po la lnga/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang ngo*// dang po ni slob dpon sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pa la/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ 'og gi bsgom byar 'chad pa'i khrus stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khrus kyi chus/ rtsa dkyil la mi reg pa'i sar sgo rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po la phyogs pa'i re kha gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ge'i khrir zla ba'i gdan dbang stegs 'di phreng ba'i dgongs pa/ la slob ma rnams 'khod par gyur par dmigs la/

spro na/ rab gnas kyi nang nas 'byung ba ltar gyi bgegs sbyang ba dang sdig pa sbyang ba'i tshul rnams bya'o// de nas slar yang slob ma skad cig gis dpal dgyes pa rdo rjer gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ slob ma las bum gyi chus bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug la zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon yum gyi pad+ma nas thon pa skad cig gis hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa sngon po yum dang bcas par gyur/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yum dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs| oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas zhu ba slob dpon gyi spyi bo nas zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas byang sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa de dag la nang dbang bskur ba ni rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ bi bhu tis bzhed cing phreng ba'i dgongs pa yang ngo*// dbang bskur ba pad+ma nas phyung ba mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum dang bcas pa'i rnam par dbang stegs sna tshogs pad+ma dang seng ge'i khrir zla ba'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ ces mos nas/ rnam rgyal bum pas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum chu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes mi bskyod pa dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po/ dā ri ka pas/ mi bskyod bsam gtan gsum rdzogs pa'i// zhes dang*/ klu dbyangs kyis/ de nas rang bzhin shes rnal 'byor// pa yis slob mar dbang bskur phyir// gus pas rgyal ba de dag kun// slar byon ched du bskul bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/

bum dbang bskur ba rnams la dkyil 'khor pas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad dgos pa'i phyir rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang thob dgos par mngon no// zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma kī bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa de dag snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdul tshon nam/ ras bris sam/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams la dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i lwa ba pas/ ma rig pa lnga yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga po rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ thams cad du sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa rig pa'i lha mos dbang bskur bar byed pa'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs su/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bsnams nas 'dzin/ rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing glu gar mdzad de/ me tog dang*/ gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar po rdo rje snying po'i rgyan las/ til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i// rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni// byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis kyi glu len/ khro mo rnams kyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing phyogs mtshams su 'khod de bgegs bskrad par gyur/ ces mos te rnam rgyal bum pa bteg nas/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog

/sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / zung 'jug gsal ba las/ bum pa bzung ste bkra shis pa'i// tshigs su bcad pa thog mar bklag /ces slob ma la bkra shis brjod cing glu blangs te/ rdo rje dang bcas pas bum pa slob ma'i mgor bzhag /rol mo sgrog cing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs/ yum kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ sngags 'di klu dbyangs gis so// zhes brjod la/ bum chu spyi bor blugs shing 'thung du gzhug /de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang bde ba phun sum tshogs pa nyams su myong*| chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i sgo nas bstim lwa ba pa dang*/ bha wa bha dra/ dā ri ka pa rnams kyis dbang lha ba spu'i bu ga nas bstim zhes gsungs shing*/ bstim tshul yang lwa ba pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bkug nas bstim par bshad do// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis sbyong byed chu'i dbang bskur thob/ sbyang gzhi zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur te/ sbyangs 'bras chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed do// sdom 'byung las/ dbang lnga de bzhin gshegs bdag nyid// ces dang*/ phreng ba las/ dbang lnga ye shes dag gi sa bon rgyas par byed pa'i phyir// dam tshig bdag nyid mos par bya'o// zhes dang*/

pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas/ phung po lnga nyon mongs lnga dag par dbang lngar bshad do// zhes gsungs pa'o| | gnyis pa ni/ slob mas/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar bdag la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/ dbu rgyan oṃ dang rin po che las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje ser po/ zhal brgyad| phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis rin po che/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma bdag med ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi sogs nas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur pa'i dbu rgyan rin 'byung du gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pas zhu nas dbu rgyan gyi rnam par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang dbu rgyan bsnams nas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs nas| bgegs bskrad par gyur gyi bar brjod/ dbu rgyan thogs te/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes slob ma'i spyi bo dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ rna ltag g.yas/ rgyab/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su rim pas bzhag cing*/ oṃ tsakra badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes mgor bskon nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ gis dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zung 'jug gsal ba las/ dbu rgyan la dar dpyangs brkyangs nas badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ

zhes brjod de/ mnyam pa nyid du thal mo bya ba klu dbyangs kyi dgongs pa'o// zhes brgyan par byas la/ bum pa thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hās bum chu spyi bor blug cing blud la/ de ltar brtan byed kyi chu'i dbang bskur bas lus sogs nas/ thams cad rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas/ mchod pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ de dag gis sbyong byed cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ sbyang gzhi nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur te/ sbyangs 'bras mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed do// gsum pa ni/ rdo rje can sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dang rdo rje hrīḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med gur las/ slob ma 'jig rten dbang bsam pa// rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa// zhes gsungs so// dgyes pa rdo rje dmar po/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis pad+ma dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo bdag med ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i rdo rje 'od dpag med du gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pas zhu nas rdo rje'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang rdo rje bsnams nas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs nas/ bgegs bskrad par gyur gyi bar brjod/ rdo rje thogs te/
sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang ni de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab tu 'grub phyir rdo rje zung*/

tshigs bcad 'di gur las byung*| oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ 'di gur gyi gnyis pa las byung*/ zhes/ slob ma'i snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su reg cing*/ lag pa g.yas su byin la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar brtan byed kyi chu dbang sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas/ mchod pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ de dag gis sbyong byed rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob/ sbyang gzhi 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur te/ sbyangs 'bras sor rtogs ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed do// bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje can sogs kyis gsol ba btab| bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dang dril bu khaṃ dang ral gri las don grub gur gyi gnyis pa las/ lha mo yum la 'khyud ldan pa'i/ 'dir tshig rkang gsum ma dper ma gsal/ dgyes pa rdo rje ljang gu/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis ral gri dang g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma bdag med ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa| zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi sogs nas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i dril bu don grub tu gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pas zhu nas dril bu'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang dril bu bsnams nas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs nas bgegs bskrad par gyur gyi bar brjod/ dril bu thogs te/ oṃ/ dril bu shes rab dang ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal gyur cig

/oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti sogs rdo rje'i skabs ltar brjod/ slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe aḥ sngags 'di dang tshig 'di gnyis klu dbyangs kyi dgongs pa'o/ /bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod// ces brjod la dkrol/ slob dpon gyis ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar brtan byed kyi chu dbang sogs nas don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas/ mchod pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ de dag gis sbyong byed dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ sbyang gzhi phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur te/ sbyangs 'bras bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ don grub kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed do// lnga pa ni/ rdo rje can sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma laṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje dkar po/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pas yum dbyings phyug bdag med ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi sogs nas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ces dang*/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang rdo rje dril bu mnyam par bzung ste ming gi dbang bskur te/ gzugs rdo rje ma sogs nas bgegs bskrad par gyur gyi bar brjod/ rdo rje dril bu mnyam par bzung nas slob ma'i mgor/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye zhes bos nas/ kye zhes bod kyi 'bod pa yin la/ de la dpal gyi sgra sbyor dgos pa ni mar me mdzad bzang pos bzhed/ dā ri ka pas/ dpal dang rdo rje'i sgra ldan pa// slob dpon gyis ni lan gsum 'bod// ces gsungs so// dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes che ge mo'i mal du sngar gyi me tog dor ba'i tshe gtso bo la phog na/ skyes pa rnams la/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ bzhad pa rdo rje/ rnam par sgeg pa/ dga' ba sgeg pa/ rol pa rang byung*/ zhe sdang he/ snying rje thugs/ hūm̐ mdzad/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes sogs ming gi mthar rdo rje spras pa rnams dang*/ bud med la/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ phyag ma/ byed ma/ phreng ba ma/ mā ma kī/ zhe sdang dga' ma zhes sogs ming gi thog mar rdo rjes spras pa rnams gang rung dang*/ me tog 'khor la phog pa yin na skyes pa la don yod rdo rje/ rta mchog /dam tshig gi pha rol tu phyin pa/ las/ rlung*/ reg bya/ phrag dog ces sogs kyi ming mthar rdo rjes brgyan pa dang*/ bud med la rdo rje snyems ma/ sgyu ma/ rgod ma/ sgrol ma/ gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ dam tshig ma/ dga' ma sogs kyi ming gi thog mar rdo rjes brgyan pa kho na gdags so// de nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar brtan byed kyi chu dbang sogs nas| rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas mchod pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ de dag gis sbyong byed ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ sbyang gzhi gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ sbyangs 'bras me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub bsgrub la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed do// dbang de dag gis spang bya ma rig pa nyon mongs pa lnga spangs nas thob bya rig pa'i ye shes lnga thob par byed pas na rig pa'i ye shes kyi dbang ste/

phreng ba las/ chu la sogs pa'i dbang 'di rnams ma rig pa'i gnyen por nus pa nyid du sgrub par byed pas/ rig pa'i dbang zhes brjod do// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// 'di thob pas bya rgyud kyi rgyud mtha' dag nyan pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ sngags bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// de nas slob ma skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum du gsal bar gyur par dmigs te/ āḥlas byung ba'i gri gug shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i thod khrag thabs bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur ces dmigs te/ slob ma'i lag g.yas su gri gug dang*/ g.yon du thod pa gtad de/ shes rab stong pa'i gri gug dang*// thabs mchog bde ba'i thod khrag bcas// he ru ka dpal la bstan to// phran tshegs 'grub pa'i rjes gnang sbyin// zhes yum gyi rtsa sngags brjod la gtad/ de dag gis zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmugs pa dang*/ dgra sde 'jig pa dang*/ bsad pa la sogs pa'i las phran bu rnams sgrub pa dang*/ mchil lham bgo ba dang*/ char dbab pa dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba bzung ba la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub thams cad ci dga' bar sgrub par gyis shig /ces go ba sbyin/ 'di ni las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rigs su/ rjes gnang ste rig pa'i dbang gi cha lag yin pas rkang grangs zur du mi bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la gsum/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ dbang dngos/ mtha' rten no| |dang po gsum/ rdo rje'i dam tshig /dril bu'i dam tshig /phyag rgya'i dam tshig go// dang po la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ slob mas/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

dā ri ka pas/ de ltar slob ma'i dbang thob nas// rgyud rnams thos shing gsang sngags thob// lam rnams shes te bgrod nus na// rdo rje slob dpon nyid bya phyir// tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// las bum gyi chus slob ma bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug pa sogs sngar ltar las/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma la 'khyud par gyur/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang seng ge'i khrir zla ba'i gdan la 'khod par gyur gyi bar rig dbang gi sngon ltar bsgoms la/ slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba'i rdo rjer gyur par mos la/ lwa ba pa dang*/ dā ri ka pas/ hūm̐ las rdo rje bskyed par gsungs so// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni| |rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// gang la dmigs pa lha yi sku| |phyag rgya chen po skye ba'i rgyu// gang la dbyings na bcom ldan 'das// mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu zhes// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi ming btags nas bstan pa kun snying gis bzhed do// zhes sbyin/ des kyang stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i byang sems rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje ste/ de mtshon byed du 'dzin pa'i blos slob mas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yas pas rdo rje gsor te snying khar bzung*| gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ dril bu dbyangs tha ma aḥlas byung ba'i dril bur gyur par mos la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad| |khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/

tshigs bcad 'di gur gyi le'u bzhi pa las byung*/ /zhes byin la/ des kyang chos kun rang bzhin med pa'i sgra dril bus bsgrags par mos la/ slob mas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ tshig bcad 'di rnams dpal mchog las byung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe aḥ sngags 'di slob mas brjod dgos pa lwa ba pa dang*/ dā ri ka pa sogs kyis bshad do// zhes brjod cing g.yon pas bzung la dkrol/ gsum pa ni/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar mos te/ slob dpon gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// rang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des ni phyag rgya rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgya byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyod pas// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes go ba sbyin no// gnyis pa ni/ slob sngon po'am dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa yum yang rang 'dra ba bya'o// ma rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba ye shes kyi phyag rgya rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje dril bu mnyam par bsnol te sbyar bas 'khyud pa las/ bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting 'dzin skyes par gyur ces mos nas/ slob mas sngar ltar rdor dril gyi de kho na nyid dran pas rdor dril bzung nas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ slob dpon gyis/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor bas// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod/ bsdus rgyud las// dpal ldan shes rab bla ma la// dang por reg pa gang yin pa// bum pa'i dbang ni de nyid do// dgyes rdor las/ shes rab bcu drug ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'di slob dpon gyi dbang dngos gzhir ngos 'dzin dgos shing*/

slob dpon gyi dbang gi bum dbang yang 'di la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas 'khyud pa'i rgya dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni slob dpon gyi dbang dngos gzhir ngo sprad la/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che ba dril bu chen po bzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs mtshams su 'khod de bgegs bskrad par gyur gyi bar brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis bum dbang bskur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ 'di yis khams lnga gshegs mas sbyangs shing*/ phung po lnga gshegs pas sbyong ba grub chen mang pos bzhed do// zhes pa nas/ ba spu'i sgo nas bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog dor zhing brtan par byas la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod do// gsum pa la gsum/ de kho na nyid dang las rim bshad pa/ sngags sbyin zhing mig sman bku ba/ me long bstan cing mda' 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ rigs kyi bu dkyil 'khor zhes pa ni| ji skad du/ mdor na gzhal yas khang nyid ni rnam snang gi rang bzhin no// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don no// yid kyi dkyil 'khor ro// gzhal med khang ni sems kyi khang pa brtsigs pa'o// de yang gru bzhir 'dug pa ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// byams pa la sogs pa ni thig bzhi sogs so// thig gdab pa ni chos rjes su dran pa'o// ye shes kyi thig ni lta ba kun las rnam par grol ba'o| |rgyan rnams ni tshul khrims la sogs pa'o// dad pa dang dbang po la sogs pa ni rwa lnga'o// rnam thar bzhi ni sgo bzhi'o// ka ba dang bcas pa'i rta babs ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o| |kha khyer bzhi ni dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'o// sgo khyud bzhi ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'o// me tog gi phreng ba chun por 'phyang ba ni byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi'o// ka ba brgyad ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do// sgrib pa kun dag cing ting nge 'dzin ye shes rtag pa lam gyi ye shes sogs ni rnga yab bo// nyon mongs pa kun gzhom pa'i phyir do shal rnams so// nyon mongs phyogs gzhom pa'i phyir du do shal phyed pa'o// nyon mongs pa 'phrog pa ni dra ba'o// tshogs gnyis kyi sbyor ba ni 'khor lo zhes bya'o// zhes rten gzhal yas khang gi de nyid dang*/

zhe sdang rnam shes dag pa chos dbyings ye shes ni gtso bo yab yum/ ji skad du/ phung po lnga ni mdor bsdus na// sangs rgyas lnga ni rab tu grags// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don no// gti mug dang gzugs phung dag pa'i me long ye shes ni gau rī/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes ni tsau rī/ 'dod chags dang gti mug 'du shes dag pa sor rtog ye shes ni be tā lī/ phrag dog dang 'du byed dag pa bya grub ye shes ni ghasma rī/ sa khams dag pa byams pa tshad med ni puk+ka sī/ chu khams dag pa snying rje tshad med ni sha wa rī/ me khams dag pa dga' ba tshad med ni tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rlung khams dag pa btang snyom tshad med ni ḍoṃ bhi nī/ dga' ba mngon du byas pa ni gling bu ma/ mchog tu dga' ba mngon du byas pa ni pi wang ma/ rnam par dga' ba mngon du byas pa ni mu kuṇ+ḍa/ lhan skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas pa ni rdza rnga ma/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa mngon du gyur pa ni rta gdong ma/ kun 'byung gi bden pa mngon du gyur pa ni phag gdong ma/ 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa ni khyi gdong ma/ lam gyi bden pa mngon du gyur pa ni seng gdong ma rnams so// zhes brten pa lha'i dag pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/

ji skad du slob dpon gyi las kyi rim pa yang bsten no zhes pa'i don no// gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ srung ba dang*/ phyir zlog pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ der slob ma zhugs te dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rmugs pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang char dbab pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa'o// zhes las rim rnams bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzlas la/ bcom ldan bdag gi byin lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gtso bo la snyan gsan dbab ste/ de nas slob mas/ tshigs bcad 'di legs grub kyi rgyud nas gsungs so// sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung ba zhal nas thon slob ma'i rna ba g.yas su zhugs/ sngags 'khor gyi dmigs pa 'di bi bhu ti'i dgongs pa'o// snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas su bskor te gnas par gyur pa dpon slob gnyis kas mos te/ gtso bo yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ sa bon rnams kyi rjes zlos tshar gsum byed du bcug go// de nas gser gyi thur ma sor bcu bdun pa rdo rjes mtshan zhing rtse mo bra bo'i 'bru lta bus/ rin po che'i snod du gnas pa'i mig sman sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blangs te/ slob ma'i mig tu prāṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ thur ma prāṃ las bskyed cing sher phyin rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ yi ge prāṃ la mi shes pa'i rab rib thams cad 'dus par bsam la thur mas bsal ba'o// mig sman byugs pas zhi bar bsam// zhes grub chen mang pos bzhed do//

ces brjod la/ mig sman bku ba dang 'byed pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ sher phyin pad+ma'i sa bon no// thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis// ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin// rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi// mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal// zhes brjod nas ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal te ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par gyur par dmigs so// gsum pa ni/ me long bstan la/ āḥlas byung ba'i me long āḥzhes dang*/ tshigs bcad 'di rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs/ tshigs bcad dang pos rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ gnyis pas glo bur rnam dag bstan to// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med la// chos rnams de ltar shes nas khyod// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes bstan to// de nas mda' gzhu gtad de/ hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu hoḥ dā ri ka pas/ hoḥyis sbyangs pa'i mda' gzhu dag /slob ma'i lag tu sbyin pa ni| |zhes gsungs te/ bgegs la 'phen pa'i bsam pas phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og ste drug tu 'phen stangs bya'o// chos nyid gzhu la ye shes mda'// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun la 'phongs// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// thams cad rjes su mnyes par bgyi// sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rjes su chags par gyis shig /ces brjod la slob mas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes brjod la/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams bcu la mda' 'phang ba'i tshul bya'o// de dag gis slob dpon sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pa la/

rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang rjes 'jug dang bcas pa thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ de ltar bum dbang thob bya'i yul ni/ sbyor ba bdun pa las/ ri mo dang ni lus kyi las// dkyil 'khor du ni de nyid thob// ces dang*/ gang la dbang na/ sbyor gsum yan lag bcas pa byung*// de la yang dag rten par bya// gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams kyi// snang srid dben pa rtogs pa'o// zhes dang*/ dag bya ni/ srog gcod la sogs snga phyi'i// dag dang nye bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ ngo bo ni/ de'i rang gi ngo bo ni// rgyu yi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ sgra bshad ni/ snod du rung phyir bum dbang ni// blug gtor dag par byed pa'i dbang*// 'di ni yang dag rgyud rim pa'i// lung gis nges par bshad pa'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ bum dbang gi dam tshig ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*// sbom po brgyad po bsrung bar bshad// gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul lo// gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ yol ba sogs kyis dben pa'i nang du slob dpon longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhugs pa la/ slob ma rang gi sring mo la sogs pa'i bud med la gnas ma nyams shing*/ gzugs bzang ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ lang tshos mdzes pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa dang*/ phyag chen thig le gnyis pa las/ bzhin bzang mig gi dkyus ring ba// gzugs bzang lang tshos brgyan pa ni// bcu gnyis yang na bcu drug gam// ma rnyed nyi shu lon pa'ang rung*// nyi shu yan chad phyag rgya gzhan// des ni dngos grub thob ring byed// sring mo yang ni bu mo yang*// chung ma bla ma la 'bul bya// zhes bshad cing*/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa ni dbul bar mi bya ste/

dam tshig dang mi ldan pa ni rig ma bsten par mi bya'o// zhes sbom po'i ltung bar bshad do// maṇ+ḍal phul thal mo sbyar te/ slob mas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// mgon pos rjes su bzung bar mdzod// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas mig dar bcings la/ slob dpon dgyes pa rdo rje zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i pang du rig ma skad cig gis rdo rje bdag med ma sngo sangs zhal gcig sogs nas yab dang sbyor ba zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar las/ yab yum bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas byang sems dkar dmar bab pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud de thig le'i rnam par rdo rje nor bu lhan skyes brtan par byas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sngags 'di 'dus pa dang gur las byung*/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ de nas thog mar yab kyi thig le de nyid mtheb srin btsir nas dung chos su gnas pa/ slob ma skad cig gis 'od dpag med du gnas pa'i khar sbyin par mos la/ gsang dbang gi rdzas sgrub tshul ni/ 'dus pa phyi ma las/ rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor ba yis// rdo rje can kun yang dag bsdu// sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis// de dag thams cad snying khar bsdus// rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas ni// slob ma'i khar ni dbab par bya// zhes gsungs so// slob dpon gyis dung chos su ga pur ro ma dang sbyar ba thogs te/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi// oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs yab kyi snying po brjod la/ slob ma'i khar sbyin| slob mas/a hoḥm hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod la myang*/ dā ri ka pas/ yang na tshig gi las skyes nas// grol ba'i bdag nyid sbyin par bya// a hoḥsu kha zhes brjod nas// lus kun bde bas khyab par bya// zhes gsungs so// dbang 'di ni slob ma'i khar sbyin pa'i tshe/

mig gis mthong na ma dad kyi dogs pas gdong g.yogs bcings te de'i mig dang lag pa'i yul min par bya'o// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo byang sems de nyid myangs pas bde ba ting nge 'dzin bskyed par gyur par mos la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de nas rig mas kyang gos med par langs te/ pad+mar gnas pa'i thig le phyung ste dung chos su bstsal ba slob ma 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs kar sbyin par gyur par dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis dung chos su sin+dhu ra dang chang sbyar ba thogs te/ 'das pa'i shes rab phyag rgya yis// sras bcas rgyal bar dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ aṃ aḥni sogs yum gyi snying pos sbyin/ slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su kha/ brjod la btung*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi ngo bo byang sems de nyid myangs pas bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyed par mos la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥpra we sha ya hoḥ zhes mig dar bsal/ de dag gis slob dpon longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhugs pa la/ yab yum snyoms 'jug la brten nas kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rang byin rlabs kyi rdzogs rim dang grol lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin no| gsang dbang gi ngo bo ni// phyag chen thig le gnyis pa las// sbom po tha rtag sbyor ba yis// longs spyod nang du gzhug par bya// de tshe yang dag ye shes kyi// bu mo bde ba ni lta bu// zhes gsungs shing*/ gsang dbang thob bya'i yul sogs ni/ sbyor ba bdun pa las/ ltag pa byang sems zhes bya ba'i// dkyil 'khor du ni dbang du thob// ces dang*/ de'i rang gi ngo bo ni// gsung gi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no// sbun la sogs pa lnga phye ba'i// dag dang nye bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/

rdo rje zla ba'i ngo bo ni// sgyu dra'i ting 'dzin brtan par bya// mig sogs nang gi chos rnams kyis// sgreng dang dben par rtog pa'o// nā ro pas kyang*/ gsang dbang thob kyang sgyu lus bsgom par bshad cing*/ 'di'i dam tshig tu bdud rtsi lnga brtan pa dang*/ srog chags mi gsad/ bud med mi spong*/ bla ma mi smod pa rnams kha sbyor las gsungs so// gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsum pa sher dbang ni/ slob dpon chos kyi skur bzhugs pa la maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor ba las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che| |mnga' bdag bdag la de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ mig dar bcings la/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag tu mtshan ldan gyi rig ma dngos sam yid kyis gtad la/ 'dus pa phyi ma las/ mchog tu dad cing shes rab ni// gzugs bzang tshogs la rtag tu dga'// sbyor ba dag gi bya ba gzhol// dam tshig can gyi dam tshig dag /bla ma la ni slob ma yis// yon rnams legs par phul nas ni// bla mas de ni byin brlabs te// sgrub pa po la sbyin par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// sdom pa dang mi ldan pa ni rig ma mi rung ngo*// dbang gi dus lhan skyes ye shes yul tsam zhig myong ba yin la phyis goms pa'i dbang gis yun ring du nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ / lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs ldan yid 'ong ma// khyer zhig khyer zhig sems dpa' che| |khyed la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes byin pas/ rig mas/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod ji ltar dga' ba smros// zhes dris pa la/

slob mas/ bshang gci khu khrag sha chen bza'// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// zhes lan btab pas/ lha mo dgyes nas skra bshig dri zhim pos byugs pa'i lus gcer bur phyung nas bha ga rgyas pa kha phyes nas bstan te| e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ */bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun du bdag gnas so/ tshig bcad 'di rnams sngags dang bcas pa zhal lung las byung*| | sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spangs pa/ phreng ba las/ rab byung gi rten khyad par can gyi 'du shes gsum ldan gyis dbang po gnyis sprod ni/ nyes pa med par gsungs pa'o// dus 'khor rtsa 'grel las rab byung la dbang gsum pa tshig tsam gyis sbyin par gsungs pas gang bder bya'o// de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes brjod par mos/ phyag chen thig le gnyis pa nas// pad+ma'i snying po'i dbus nas ni// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma ni bzhugs// de ma rnyed pa'i bar du ni// thabs gzhan la ni byang chub med// de ni rang bzhin dag pa'i gzugs// phra mos phra mo yang dag mchog /ces dang*/ zhal lung las/ na le gnyis po brtsal bar bya// rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug rtsa// gzung 'dzin bral ba bha ga'i dbus// bla ma'i gsang sngags stobs kyis ni// sor mo'i go ba bya dgos so// zhes gsungs pas sbyor lam gzhan du shes par bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje zhabs bzhi sa la brdabs pas lha dang lha min zhes pa nas/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ de'i pang du rig ma de nyid skad cig gis yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngo sangs la sogs nas bde ba chen po'i sgra shī shī shī zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar la/

shī'i mjug tu ha ha ha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung la| slob dpon dang slob ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas yab yum spyan drangs pas lus byin gyis brlabs nas/ bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pas rjes chags gtum mo'i mes gtsug tor gyi haṃ zhu ba thig le'i rnam par spyi bo nas mgrin par bab pas dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar slebs pas mchog gi dga' ba/ snying kha nas lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ dga' bzhi nyams su myong bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nges par byas/ slar hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gyen du drangs pa lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par khyad dga' ba/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar byas pa dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ de ltar rig ma dang dga' bral dang mchog dga' gnyis kyi bar du sher dbang gi ngo bo skye bar lwa pas bshad do// de'i tshe ji ltar nus pas bzung la/ ma zin na dal bus btang nas chu skyes las lce nyid kyis blangs te/ de kho na nyid kyi bsam pas dam tshig gi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems btung bar bya'o//

snyoms 'jug gi dus byang sems lte ba nas nor bu'i rtse mor bab pa'i tshe zhal lung las/ chos sku rab dga' mkha' mnyam par// shi dang sbyar dang gnyid log dang*// gdul dang 'khrig dus skad cig tsam// myong bar gyur pas de nyid rtogs// zhes skabs lngar chos skur rtogs par bshad do// skyes pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes de nyid dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥsogs kyis mig dar bsal nas/ de dag gis slob dpon chos kyi skur bzhugs pa la/ rig ma'i las rgya la brten pa bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ dbang gsum pa thob bya'i yul sogs ni/ sbyor ba bdun pa las/ bha ga rnam dag ces bya ba'i| |dkyil 'khor du ni de nyid thob// ces dang*// de yang rang gi ngo bo ni// thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ brnab sems la sogs snga phyi yi// dag dang nyes par mi 'gyur ro// dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs zhog /sdom pa mchog ni sbyin pa'o// zhes dang*/ thabs kyi khyad par che ba'i phyir// rdo rje lta bur yang dag gnas// mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir// brtul zhugs cho ga rim pas brtan// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo yi// chos kun mngon par rtogs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'o// yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam phyag rgya chen po dang sbyor lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ slob dpon ngo bo nyid kyi skur bzhugs pa la/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar te/ kha sbyor las/ zab cing rgya che la mos na// tshig gi rin chen dbang bskur bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// yang dag ye shes chen po ste// rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo la// bdag ni shin tu nges shes skyes// gnyis med ye shes 'di nyid ni| |'gro ba gzhan la yod ma yin// chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di 'thung phyir// slob dpon gtso la gsol 'debs kyi// gal te bka' drin thob gyur na// 'jigs pa med pa'i bka' drin stsol| |shes rab ye shes dbang bskur gyi// sems kyi rdo rje rnam par sbyong*// da ni bdag la bzhi pa yang*// 'dren pas bka' drin mdzad du gsol//

gsol 'debs 'di dā ri ka pas gsungs so| | zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod la dbang gsum pa ngo sprad pa'i don gyi lhan skyes de mtshon byed dpe'i lhan skyes de nyid 'bras bu don dam byang sems kyi myu gu yin la/ de'i rgyun bskyangs pas gong 'phel du gyur nas sgrib med kyi de kho na nyid yan lag bdun ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po rdo rje 'chang du shar ba ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ de yang brtag pa gnyis pa'i phyi ma le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ */rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ */rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ */khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ */ zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i dus kyi ye shes 'di ni gtan tshig la sogs pas rtogs par dka' bas na ches phra zhing*/ rnam rtog gi mtshan mas ma phyed pas na rdo rje/ shin tu rnam par dag pas na nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ sgrib pa mtha' dag zad pas na rdul bral/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i go 'phang stsol bas na mthar phyin/ gdod ma nas ma skyes pas na zhi ba/ de lta bu phyag rgya chen po de nyid gzhir bskyed bya skyed byed/ lam du bsgom bya sgom byed/ 'bras bu 'thob bya thob byed sogs tha dad kyi dbye ba dang bral bas na/ khyod rang de yi pha zhes bya ste/ don de nyid khyod kyi go zhing rig pas rtogs par bya ba dag go// zhes tshig gis ngo sprad la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥsogs kyis mig dar bsal| de dag gis slob dpon ngo bo nyid kyi skur bzhugs pa la/ tshig tsam gyi sbyor ba la brten nas don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ lam bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim mtha' bral chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig ni/ dā ri ka pas/

khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// gzhan gyi bud med rnams spyad nas// ma byin pa yang khyod kyis longs// thams cad la yang rdzun tshig smros// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnyis pa spyi'i mtha' rten la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba'o// dang po lnga/ brtul zhugs/ brtul zhugs kyi don ni/ de nyid snang ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi don du nges par bya ba ste/ zhes gsungs so/ / lung bstan/ rjes gnang*/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob mas/ bsam pa sna tshogs byed pa yis| |sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i thabs// gang zhig spyod pa rnams sbyong ba// brtul zhugs rnam gsum bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba btab pas/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ shes rab ma de'i lag pa slob ma'i lag par gtad cing*/ de gnyis ka'i lag pa nas slob dpon gyi lag g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas bzung zhing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dpang du btsugs te/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ tshigs bcad 'di rnams 'dus pa phyi ma las byung ngo*// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa nyid// de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni// khyod kyis nam yang bya ba min// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spangs pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// zhes brjod la sbyin/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ de nas slob ma rnams skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gyur par mos te/ tshig bcad 'di rnams dang*/ sngags 'di ni de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu dang po dang*/

gur gyi le'u dang por gsungs so// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// zhes rdo rje g.yas su sbyin/ de nas slob mas kyang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ hi lngas ni ye shes lnga mtshon no// hūm̐ gis chos dbyings rnam par dag pa ston pa'o// zhes brjod la bzung*/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ 'dus pa'i le'u bcu drug pa las// sngags kyi sdom pas kun tu bsdams// sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras bu rnams// bza' dang bca' ba thams cad spyod// de nas kha ṭ+wāṃ dang*| ḍā ma ru/ thod pa rnams la lha'i snying po lan gsum bzlas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi nang gsang bar yang dag gnas// kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u thod pa'i snod// byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis// zhes brjod la sbyin/ de nas slob ma skyes pa yin na yab dang*/ bud med yin na yum du bskyed pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi bdag gi rnal 'byor ltar gsal 'debs su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis 'khor lo thogs te/ brtag gnyis las// 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen dbang*// lag par rnam par snang mdzad dran| |ska rags la ni don yod gnas// zhes pa'i don no// nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// spyi bor 'khor lo rus pa ste// bu khyod rnam shes phung po ni// mi bskyod pa yi ngo bor gsal// zhe sdang gnas su dag pa'i brda// chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan/ oṃ dha ra dha ra dhā ra ya dhā ra ya marta marta badz+ra dhṛka phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mgo bor bcings/ snyan rgyan thogs te// nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// rna bar rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod 'du shes phung po ni// snang ba mtha' yas ngo bor gsal// 'dod chags gnas su dag pa'i brda// kun rtogs ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan/

oṃ dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu ā ro lika phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rna bar btags/ mgul rgyan thogs la/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu| |mgul rgyan rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod tshor ba'i phung po ni// rin chen 'byung ldan ngo bor gsal// ser sna gnas su dag pa'i brda// mnyam nyid ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan| oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta mo be dā ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mgul par bskon/ gdu bu thogs la/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// yan lag rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod gzugs kyi phung po ni// gti mug gnas su dag pa'i brda// me long ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan// oṃ sha shwa ta pa ra ma sha shwa ta e h+ye hi dzi na dzika phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gdu bu rnams phyag zhabs la g.yogs/ ska rags thogs te/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// rked par rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod 'du shes phung po ni// don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gsal// phrag dog gnas su dag pa'i brda// bya grub ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan// oṃ phu phuḥhe hi pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rked par ska rags bcings// rus pa'i se ral kha sbyin zhing*// nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// se ral rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod ye shes phung po ni// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor gsal// nga rgyal gnas su dag pa'i brda| |rang byung ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan/ oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā+opa ni tra kan+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa// zhes se ral kha bcings/ rgyan 'di rnams rus chen kho na la bya dgos shing*/ rgyan 'di rnams slob mas dngos su gyon pa'am gyon par mos pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma me tog phog pa'i lha gang yin der gsal btab ste/ 'di ni lwa ba pa'i dgongs pa'o// slob dpon sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs kyi chos gos gsum dang snam sbyar gyon zhing mchil lham phud de gding ba'i steng du 'grengs te/

lag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas snam sbyar gyi grwa gnyis nas seng ge bag phebs kyi rna ba ltar byas la snying khar bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ dā ri ka pas/ mchog sbyin mi 'jigs pa gnyis gdams ngag gcig tu gsungs so// rgyal ba dang 'khor 'das dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa slob dpon dang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mos te/ sa ra has/ de tshe he ru ka dpal dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang bla mar bcas// mgrin gcig lung ston byed par bsam// oṃ/ srid pa ngan 'gro las bton nas// srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir// rdo rje sems pa de bzhin gshegs// bdag ni khyod la lung bstan bgyi/ kye dpal zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i mtshan nas bos te/ 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ gang la ngas phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang mgrin gcig dgyes bzhin pas/ khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do// kho bo'i phyag rgya 'di nyid dang sngags 'di yi stobs yin no// zhes brjod la lung bstan to// gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo thogs te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ de ni rkang pa'i bar 'og tu// chos kyi 'khor lo bzhag par bya// de nas lag pa g.yas par yang*// shin tu bzang po'i dung sbyin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo| |oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// bya spyod rnal 'byor la sogs kyi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi// zhes bstan la sbyin/ dung dkar thogs te/ kha sbyor las| bzhi pa de ni de bzhin gshegs// zhes pa'i rjes la// byang chub sems kyi dbang gis ni// slob ma sdig dang bral ba la// de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin// zhes pa'i don no// de nas rkang pa'i bar 'og tu// chos kyi 'khor lo bzhag par bya// de nas lag pa g.yas par yang*// shin tu bzang po'i dung sbyin no// zhes gsungs pa'i don no//

dbyangs tha ma āḥlas byung ba'i dung*/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med pa// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// zhes byin la/ slob mas 'bud/ rgyud kyi po ti gtad la/ glegs bam ster ba 'di sgyu dra las bshad/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i rgyud kyi po ti/ gsang sngags kun la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin tu bzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin kun khyod la srung*// zhes brjod la g.yas su sbyin/ dril bu thogs la/ dbyangs dang po'i phyi ma las byung ba'i āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ tshigs bcad 'di rnams dpal mchog las byung*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas// kun sbyor mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes g.yon du byin la/ slob mas kyang dkrol/ de nas slob ma rnams skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad du gsal bar gyur par mos la/ tshigs bcad dang mthun pa'i rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan re thogs te/ slob ma la gtad la/ tshigs bcad 'di rnams de nyid bsdus pa las byung*/ sems can kun la phan don du// 'jig rten kun ni thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes 'khor lo gtad la/ de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ las kyi/ zhes 'don pa spos la/ phyag mtshan so sor gtad pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bshad kyi rjes gnang dang*/ de nas khyad par phrin las kun la dbang byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ ral gri slob ma'i g.yas su gtad la/ de ring nas bzung 'jig rten la// sna tshogs phrin las 'khor lo bskor// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las mchog rnams kun sgrubs shig /ces sbyin/ dgos pa ni/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma nas bshad pa'o// bzhi pa ni/

slob ma'i spyi bor gdugs dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor la skor ba gsum bskor te shar du gdugs dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba bkod la/ spyi rgyud las/ de nas bla ma bdag nyid kyis/ */de'i spyi bor gdugs kyang bzung*| |thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ */dkyil 'khor legs par bskor du gzhug */zhes slob dpon gyis gdugs 'dzin par bshad la/ lwa ba pas ni/ las kyi rdo rjes 'dzin par bshad la de gnyis gang bder bya'o// slob dpon gyis/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin pa yi// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba btab nas/ slar yang gdugs logs shig tu bzhag la dam tshig bsgrags pa ni|

dam tshig bsgrags pa 'di spyi rgyud sogs mang po nas gsungs so// da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse don du// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di las ni// phyin chad khyod la 'chi ba med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa mtha' dag bsgrub ched du// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro// khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// 'dod pa kun la spyod pa mchog /gang la'ang 'jigs med spyad par gyis// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya// 'di las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs// srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med rin chen spang mi bya// slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste// dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin// ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin// 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par byos| |'gro ba bde ba bzung bar rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur// gzhan yang gang dag cho ga ji ltar bzhin// dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra ba thugs dang bas// yang dag dgongs pa mdzad do chos nyid yin// zhes brjod/

lnga pa ni/ slob mas de ltar bgyi'o// de ring gson dang 'bras bur bcas// de ring skyes pa 'bras bu yod// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// rtog pa'i mtshan byed rab 'jigs pa// nyon mongs 'di ni brgal dka' zhing*// mnar med la sogs skye ba na// mgon po khyod kyis bdag bsgral to// bag chags thams cad spangs pa yin// byang chub dam par bdag 'tshal ba// khyod zhabs lam gyi bka' drin gyis// rdzogs pa nyid du bdag gyur to// zhes sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab tu byed pa'i gsum pa nas gsungs so| |de ltar dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob nas/ slar bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyid// ces gsum brjod la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lus longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ de nas/ slob ma las ni yon blang bya// des kyang gus pas dbul bya ste / /de bzhin yid 'ong chung ma dang*| |rang gi lus dang sa gzhi dang*// mdor na bya ba de 'dra ba// ji ltar bla ma mnyes gyur pa// bla ma mnyes na dngos grub 'gyur// gzhan du min zhes thub pas gsungs// slob dpon bla med byed pa po// rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa las// de'i bsod nams la byas shing*// dka' thub ma byas pa yang ci// zhes gsungs/ slob mas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do/ ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ a bha ya dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin pa'i dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ rtags pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa grub chen mang pos/ rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dbang bskur tshul khyad par med par bshad pas de ltar rtogs par bya'o// bzhi pa rjes kyi lhag ma bya ba ni/

mchod phreng ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing longs spyad la| lhag ma bsngos te/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar ci rigs par byas la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas thal mo sbyar te/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor mchog /ces pa nas/ da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar gyi smon lam gdab/ yig brgya tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kyi nyes pa sbyangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis| |nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// khyed rnams lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon pos de kun bzod par gsol// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa// gal te yongs su ma shes dang*| |'dir ni bya min gang bgyis pa// de kun gtso bos bzod mdzad rigs// zhes brjod la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ rdul tshon sgrub mchod dang 'brel pa yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ nub tha ma yin na/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji ltar rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi yul ni sems can gyi don dang chos kyi dbyings la kun snying gis bshad do// zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ sprul pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rang gi snying khar thim par gyur zhes mos la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ chos thams cad skye ba med par mos la/ g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas lha mtshan rim pas dbus su bsdus nas cung zad cig rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing*/ slar yang rdo rjes shar sgo'i me ri nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar tshangs thig gi lam nas 'jig la/ slar yang lha gnas kyi gdan rnams dang sgo rnams kyang*/ rdo rje'i rtse mos gzhig go// de nas shis brjod mchod phreng ltar byas la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon brkyang du gnas pa'i rdor dril bzung la khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyangs pa skam pa'i phyag rgyas/

oṃ badz+ra kī la udakī la ya sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes brjod cing phur bu rnams re re nas phyung la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes 'o ma la rgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas phur bu'i dbal bkru zhing sngags de bzlas nas 'khru ba ni/ gsang 'dus las sngags des shi ba gso bar gsungs pas/ bgegs rnams nyams par byas la slar gso ba'i don no// phur bu rnams kyang bkang ste bgegs shi ba rnams slar sos par bsam mo// phur bu'i lha la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sogs sngar phur gdab kyi skabs ltar byas la gshegs su gsol/ de nas rdul tshon rnams nges par bsdus te/ nad zhi ba sogs kyi don gnyer rnams la cung zad byin la/ lhag ma rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ gzhan gsar pa gos kyis brgyan par blugs te/ glang po'i steng ngam khyog la bzhag la/ yon bdag gis byin pa'i gos kyis rnal 'byor mas bzung la/ do li la slob dpon nam/ slob ma'i dril bu'i sgra dang*/ bkra shis pa'i glu dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*| rgyal mtshan dang*/ mchod pa rnams dang ldan pas khyer te 'bab chu chen po'am/ mtsho chen po'am/ chu zab mo'i 'gram du 'dug la/ 'o ma'am/ dri bzang dang ba byung gis byugs pa'i tshon dkar po'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'am gtso bo gang yin dang*/ 'dab ma la shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi dang*/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du rim pa bzhin du/ mtha' yas dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ karko ṭa dang*/ rigs ldan rnams snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bkug nas bzhag par bsam la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+tā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpad+mā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥtak+ṣa kā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbā su kī ye hūm̐ swā hā/
