oṃ āḥm hā pad+mā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṅkha pā lā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥkarko ṭā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥku li kā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams kyis me tog dkar po mchod la/ lag pa g.yon pa gdengs ka'i stangs dang*/ g.yas pa brkyangs te/ oṃ ā nan+ta/ bā su kī/ tak+ṣa ka /karko ṭa/ pad+ma/ ma hā pad+ma/ shaṅkha pā la/ ku li ka pā la/ de ba ti/ ma hā de ba ti/ sau ma shi khi/ ma hā sau ma shi khi/ daṇ+ḍa dha ra/ ma hā daṇ+ḍa dha ra/ a pā la/ hu lun/ nan+da/ u pa nan+da/ sā ga ra/ ma hā sā ga ra/ tap+ta/ ma hā tap+ta| shrī kan+ta/ ma hā shri kan+ta/ rat+na kan+ta/ su rū pa/ ma hā su rū pa/ bha dra hi ka /ma ho ra ga /shī li/ ma hā shī li/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhurbahu wa phruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'o ma'i gtor ma phul zhing mchod nas klu rnams la byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon gtad de chu la bskur bar bya'o// klu rnams kyis kyang bkur sti chen pos sa 'og gi 'jig rten du khyer bar bsam mo// slar yang gang du rdul tshon khyer ba'i bum pa de chus bkang nas snga ma bzhin du khyer te/ des zhi ba'i don du dkyil 'khor khang pa la sogs par gtor bar bya'o// ba lci byugs pa'i khang par gzhon nu ma rnams la 'o thug gi ston mo bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis ni nor// mkho ba'i yo byad kun bsdus nas/ spyi rgyud las kyang*/ dkyil 'khor yo byad thams cad slob dpon nyid la dbang la slob mas bgo bsha' byas na dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ slob dpon mi 'dod na gdugs dang rnga yab dang dril bu sogs sangs rgyas dang*/ gdan dang bdug spos dang dri la sogs pa chos dang*/ gos dang snod spyad sogs dge 'dun la dbul/ dge 'dun med na dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen la sbyin par bshad cing*/ bza' ba dang bca' ba rnams ci dgar phongs pa rnams la sbyin/

khyi dang bya rog la sogs par cung zad tsam yang mi sbyin no// zhes gsungs so// rang nyid kyis ni spyad par bya// slob ma sogs kyis cung zad min// rmang 'dzugs pa dang rab gnas dang*// sbyin sreg 'khor lo'i nor gang yin// de kun slob dpon kho na'i zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog nyid gsungs// zhes pa ltar bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ rnam mang rgyud sde rgya mtsho mtha' yas las// rnam grol bde ba ster ba'i bla med rgyud| |rnam dag gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje zhes// rnam kun mchog ldan lha der mgos phyag 'tshal// kun nas kha sbyor rgyud kyi bshad srol la// kun nas legs par gsungs pa'i he badz+ra| |kun mkhyen go 'phang bsgrub pa'i thabs gcig pu// kun las lhag pa'i mtshon cha can 'di ni// gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son// gsang chen nges don rtogs pa mngon du gyur// gsang ba'i lam rim mtha' dag bgrod byas nas// gsang sngags chos tshul bzang po 'di byas so// rgyud kyi de nyid tsam yang ma mthong zhing*// gsang sngags lta ba'i rnam dpyod mig med cing*// yig nag dpe ru khyer ba'i gzu lum gyis// dab dib chog gzhung yin par rab rlom zhing*// rang gi 'khor tshogs ba lang lta bu'i dbus| |rigs rus cho 'brang thod du bcings pa yi// gsang sngags bstan pa'i ru tra 'ga' med dam// dang por gsang sngags dbang bskur kun thob cing*// dam tshig spyi dang khyad par nyams med bsrungs// bar du rgyud kyi bshad srol gzhung lugs sbyangs// bskyed rdzogs lam rim ji bzhin nyams su blangs// drod rtags tshad son yi dam lha dang mjal// tha mar tshig nyung don mang sdeb legs shing*// rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma lus kun 'dus pa'i// dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan dang 'di mi mnyam// slob dpon ma bsten dbang bskur ma thob cing*// dam tshig kun nyams rgyud kyi don ma go// bzlas brjod ma dag rim gnyis mthar ma son// dbang bskur cho ga'i rnam dbye ye med cing*// rgyud don 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod mi mnga' bar// 'khor tshogs blun po'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus/

'dzin pa 'ga' zhig la// blun po'i ham stobs can 'ga'i snying stobs kyi// mi mnyam mnyam du re ba'i 'chol gtam dang*// smyon 'gros gom stabs gar du zhen pa dang*// sgom don mi shes thig gi mtshan nyid dang*// skad chen kho na dbyangs su rlom pa dang*// drod tshad ma thob bsnyen pa thems zhes zer// cal col mang po'i dbang bskur byed pa dang*// rgyud gzhung ma mthong rab gnas sbyin sreg dang*// brtan pa ma thob las tshogs sgrub pa rnams// khyod cag tshe 'dir 'bad pa don med cing*// phyi ma rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyu yin pas// byas pa don med brtul zhugs rgyang du bor| |gal te rdo rje 'chang dbang thob 'dod na// gsang sngags chos tshul ma lus kun 'doms pa'i// legs par sbyar ba'i lam srol 'dir zhugs nas// rim gnyis bzlas brjod 'bad pas nyams blang na// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal thob pa cis mi srid// de brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba rnams// rnam mkhyen gdod ma'i mgon po lhag pa'i lha// lha mchog dgyes pa rdo rje btsun mo'i 'khor// 'khor 'das go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsngo// de ltar dpal kun tshul dang*/

der ma thob pa rnams lo paṇa khungs thub mang po'i dkyil 'khor cho gas kha bskangs te sbyar ba 'di dag ni gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang man ngag mtha' dag gi don khong du chud cing*/ legs par bshad pa'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ tshig rgyan dang*/ gtsug lag rtsis dkar nag /snyan ngag /gso rig sogs rig par smra ba'i gzhung lugs mang po legs par khong du chud pa/ rim gnyis kyi lam bsgoms pas 'bras bu mngon du byas shing rang rig chos kyi sku ngo 'phrod pa/ yul dbur stod 'bri gung du skyes pa'i dge slong sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya bas| lcags mo bya lo chu shel gyi dbang po snron gyi nya ba'i dus khyad par can dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po dgongs pa chos dbyings klong du thim pa'i tshes nyer bdun la/ mdo khams stod kyi sa'i thig le zla kun dga' tshal gyi chos grwa chen po'i dbus dpal rnam gnon tshul khrims kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i gzim chung bde ba can du bris pa 'dis rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba lo ka pra dze bh+yaḥ maṅga laṃ/ kha sbyor rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i mchog /dgyes rdor mtshon cha 'bar ba yi// dkyil chog bal yul ljongs su dar// 'on kyang bod 'dir phreng ba yi// zhal lung las byung dkyil chog dag /dngos su mtshon cha can med pas// de phyir dgyes rdor mtshon can gyi// dkyil chog spros pa byed pa la// chos kyi grags pa bdag 'os zhes// mkhas pa snga mas btang snyom mdzad// de slad dkyil chog mchan bur bcas// rgyud don ma lus 'doms pa yi// chos kyi grags pas sbyar ba 'di// phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
